FROM maven:3.9.9-eclipse-temurin-17 AS build
WORKDIR /workspace
COPY . .
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.m2 \
    mvn -B -ntp -pl cart-service -am package -Dmaven.test.skip=true

FROM eclipse-temurin:17-jre
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /workspace/cart-service/target/*.jar /app/app.jar
EXPOSE 8082
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "/app/app.jar"]

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
    <parent>
        <groupId>com.heima</groupId>
        <artifactId>hmall</artifactId>
        <version>1.0.0</version>
        <relativePath>../mall-backend/pom.xml</relativePath>
    </parent>
    <artifactId>cart-service</artifactId>
    <name>cart-service</name>
    <description>cart-service</description>
    <url/>
    <licenses>
        <license/>
    </licenses>
    <developers>
        <developer/>
    </developers>
    <scm>
        <connection/>
        <developerConnection/>
        <tag/>
        <url/>
    </scm>
    <dependencies>
        <!--common-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.heima</groupId>
            <artifactId>hm-common</artifactId>
            <version>1.0.0</version>
        </dependency>
        <!-- 统一维护 OpenFeign 客户端和远程调用 DTO -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.heima</groupId>
            <artifactId>hm-api</artifactId>
            <version>1.0.0</version>
        </dependency>
        <!--web-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-webmvc</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-amqp</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <!-- OpenAPI 文档 -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springdoc</groupId>
            <artifactId>springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <!--数据库-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.mysql</groupId>
            <artifactId>mysql-connector-j</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>
        <!--mybatis-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.baomidou</groupId>
            <artifactId>mybatis-plus-spring-boot4-starter</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.baomidou</groupId>
            <artifactId>mybatis-plus-jsqlparser</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <!-- 空模块的上下文测试使用内存数据库，避免构建依赖外部 MySQL -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.h2database</groupId>
            <artifactId>h2</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>

<!--        nacos-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.alibaba.cloud</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-cloud-starter-alibaba-nacos-discovery</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.alibaba.cloud</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-cloud-starter-alibaba-nacos-config</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.alibaba.cloud</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-cloud-starter-alibaba-seata</artifactId>
        </dependency>
<!--        openFeign-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.cloud</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-cloud-starter-openfeign</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <!--负载均衡器-->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.cloud</groupId>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>io.github.openfeign</groupId>

spring:
  config:
    # IDEA 默认不会加载根目录 .env；同时兼容以仓库根目录或模块目录作为工作目录。
    import:
      - "optional:file:.env[.properties]"
      - "optional:file:../.env[.properties]"

hm:
  db:
    # IDEA 本地启动时，通过宿主机映射端口连接 Docker 中的 MySQL。
    port: ${HM_CART_DB_PORT:13307}
    host: 127.0.0.1
    database: hm_cart
    username: hm_cart_app
    password: ${HM_CART_DB_PASSWORD:change-cart-db-password}

server:
  port: 8082
  tomcat:
    threads:
      max: 25
    accept-count: 25
    max-connections: 100
spring:
  application:
    name: cart-service
  profiles:
    active: ${SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE:local}
  config:
    import:
      - "optional:file:.env[.properties]"
      - "optional:file:../.env[.properties]"
      - "optional:nacos:shared.jdbc.yaml?group=DEFAULT_GROUP&refreshEnabled=true"
      - "optional:nacos:shared.logger.yaml?group=DEFAULT_GROUP&refreshEnabled=true"
      - "optional:nacos:shared.swagger.yaml?group=DEFAULT_GROUP&refreshEnabled=true"
      - "optional:nacos:${spring.application.name}.yaml?group=DEFAULT_GROUP&refreshEnabled=true"
  cloud:
    nacos:
      server-addr: ${NACOS_SERVER_ADDR:127.0.0.1:18848}
      username: ${NACOS_USERNAME:nacos}
      password: ${NACOS_PASSWORD:nacos}
      config:
        group: DEFAULT_GROUP
      discovery:
        enabled: true
        register-enabled: true
        group: DEFAULT_GROUP
    sentinel:
      transport:
        dashboard: localhost:8090
      http-method-specify: true
  rabbitmq:
    host: ${RABBITMQ_HOST:localhost}
    port: ${RABBITMQ_PORT:5672}
    username: ${RABBITMQ_USERNAME:}
    password: ${RABBITMQ_PASSWORD:}
    virtual-host: ${RABBITMQ_VHOST:/dongqh}
    listener:
      simple:
        acknowledge-mode: auto
        default-requeue-rejected: false
        retry:
          enabled: true
          max-attempts: 3
          initial-interval: 500ms
          multiplier: 2
          max-interval: 2s
feign:
  okhttp:
    enabled: true
  sentinel:
    enabled: true
hm:
  swagger:
    title: 黑马商城购物车管理接口文档
    description: 黑马商城购物车管理接口文档
    package: com.dongqh.cartservice.controller
seata:
  enabled: ${SEATA_ENABLED:true}
  application-id: ${spring.application.name}
  tx-service-group: hmall_tx_group
  enable-auto-data-source-proxy: true
  data-source-proxy-mode: AT
  service:
    vgroup-mapping:
      hmall_tx_group: default
  registry:
    type: nacos
    nacos:
      application: seata-server
      server-addr: ${NACOS_SERVER_ADDR:127.0.0.1:18848}
      group: DEFAULT_GROUP
      namespace: ""
      cluster: default
      username: ${NACOS_USERNAME:nacos}
      password: ${NACOS_PASSWORD:nacos}

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cart;

CREATE TABLE cart (
    id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    item_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    num INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
    spec VARCHAR(1024),
    price INT NOT NULL,
    image VARCHAR(256) DEFAULT '',
    create_time TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    update_time TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE INDEX key_user_item_id ON cart(user_id, item_id);

name: ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME:-hmall-lottery}

x-java-healthcheck: &java-healthcheck
  interval: 5s
  timeout: 3s
  retries: 20
  start_period: 20s

services:
  mysql:
    image: mysql:8.4
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD:?set MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD in .env}
      TZ: Asia/Shanghai
    ports:
      - "${MYSQL_PORT:-13307}:3306"
    volumes:
      - mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql
      - ./mysql/conf/hm.cnf:/etc/mysql/conf.d/hm.cnf:ro
      - ./mysql/init/hmall.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/001_hmall.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "mysqladmin ping --protocol=TCP -h 127.0.0.1 -uroot -p$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD --silent"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 30s

  redis:
    image: redis:7.4-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      REDIS_PASSWORD: ${REDIS_PASSWORD:?set REDIS_PASSWORD in .env}
    command: ["redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes", "--requirepass", "${REDIS_PASSWORD:?set REDIS_PASSWORD in .env}"]
    ports:
      - "${REDIS_PORT:-6379}:6379"
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "redis-cli -a $$REDIS_PASSWORD --no-auth-warning ping | grep -q PONG"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:4.3.5-management-alpine
    hostname: rabbitmq
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: ${RABBITMQ_USERNAME:?set RABBITMQ_USERNAME in .env}
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: ${RABBITMQ_PASSWORD:?set RABBITMQ_PASSWORD in .env}
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_VHOST: ${RABBITMQ_VHOST:-/dongqh}
      TZ: Asia/Shanghai
    ports:
      - "${RABBITMQ_PORT:-5672}:5672"
      - "${RABBITMQ_MANAGEMENT_PORT:-15672}:15672"
    volumes:
      - rabbitmq-data:/var/lib/rabbitmq
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "rabbitmq-diagnostics", "-q", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20
      start_period: 30s

  schema-init:
    image: mysql:8.4
    restart: "no"
    depends_on:
      mysql:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD:?set MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD in .env}
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${LUCKYHUB_DB_PASSWORD:?set LUCKYHUB_DB_PASSWORD in .env}
      HM_ITEM_DB_PASSWORD: ${HM_ITEM_DB_PASSWORD:-change-item-db-password}
      HM_CART_DB_PASSWORD: ${HM_CART_DB_PASSWORD:-change-cart-db-password}
      HM_USER_DB_PASSWORD: ${HM_USER_DB_PASSWORD:?set HM_USER_DB_PASSWORD in .env}
      HM_TRADE_DB_PASSWORD: ${HM_TRADE_DB_PASSWORD:?set HM_TRADE_DB_PASSWORD in .env}
      HM_PAY_DB_PASSWORD: ${HM_PAY_DB_PASSWORD:?set HM_PAY_DB_PASSWORD in .env}
      NACOS_DB_PASSWORD: ${NACOS_DB_PASSWORD:?set NACOS_DB_PASSWORD in .env}
      SEATA_DB_PASSWORD: ${SEATA_DB_PASSWORD:?set SEATA_DB_PASSWORD in .env}
    volumes:
      - ./mysql/migrations/V001__hmall_marketing_integration.sql:/migrations/V001__hmall_marketing_integration.sql:ro
      - ./mysql/migrations/V002__hmall_order_membership_pricing.sql:/migrations/V002__hmall_order_membership_pricing.sql:ro
      - ./mysql/migrations/V003__hmall_order_coupon_pricing.sql:/migrations/V003__hmall_order_coupon_pricing.sql:ro
      - ./mysql/migrations/V004__create_item_service_database.sql:/migrations/V004__create_item_service_database.sql:ro
      - ./mysql/migrations/V005__create_cart_service_database.sql:/migrations/V005__create_cart_service_database.sql:ro
      - ./mysql/migrations/V006__create_user_service_database.sql:/migrations/V006__create_user_service_database.sql:ro
      - ./mysql/migrations/V007__create_trade_service_database.sql:/migrations/V007__create_trade_service_database.sql:ro
      - ./mysql/migrations/V008__create_pay_service_database.sql:/migrations/V008__create_pay_service_database.sql:ro
      - ./mysql/migrations/V009__add_trade_message_outbox.sql:/migrations/V009__add_trade_message_outbox.sql:ro
      - ./mysql/migrations/V010__add_pay_message_outbox.sql:/migrations/V010__add_pay_message_outbox.sql:ro
      - ./mysql/nacos.sql:/migrations/nacos.sql:ro
      - ./mysql/seata/seata-tc.sql:/migrations/seata-tc.sql:ro
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "-ec"]
    command:
      - |
        password_hex="$$(printf '%s' "$$MYSQL_PASSWORD" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
        mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          --init-command="SET @luckyhub_password = CONVERT(X'$${password_hex}' USING utf8mb4)" \
          < /migrations/V001__hmall_marketing_integration.sql
        mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          < /migrations/V002__hmall_order_membership_pricing.sql
        mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          < /migrations/V003__hmall_order_coupon_pricing.sql
        item_password_hex="$$(printf '%s' "$$HM_ITEM_DB_PASSWORD" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
        mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          --init-command="SET @hm_item_password = CONVERT(X'$${item_password_hex}' USING utf8mb4)" \
          < /migrations/V004__create_item_service_database.sql
        cart_password_hex="$$(printf '%s' "$$HM_CART_DB_PASSWORD" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
        mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          --init-command="SET @hm_cart_password = CONVERT(X'$${cart_password_hex}' USING utf8mb4)" \
          < /migrations/V005__create_cart_service_database.sql
        user_password_hex="$$(printf '%s' "$$HM_USER_DB_PASSWORD" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
        mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          --init-command="SET @hm_user_password = CONVERT(X'$${user_password_hex}' USING utf8mb4)" \
          < /migrations/V006__create_user_service_database.sql
        trade_password_hex="$$(printf '%s' "$$HM_TRADE_DB_PASSWORD" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
        mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          --init-command="SET @hm_trade_password = CONVERT(X'$${trade_password_hex}' USING utf8mb4)" \
          < /migrations/V007__create_trade_service_database.sql
        pay_password_hex="$$(printf '%s' "$$HM_PAY_DB_PASSWORD" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
        mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          --init-command="SET @hm_pay_password = CONVERT(X'$${pay_password_hex}' USING utf8mb4)" \
          < /migrations/V008__create_pay_service_database.sql
        mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          < /migrations/V009__add_trade_message_outbox.sql
        mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          < /migrations/V010__add_pay_message_outbox.sql
        nacos_password_hex="$$(printf '%s' "$$NACOS_DB_PASSWORD" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
        mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          --init-command="SET @nacos_db_password = CONVERT(X'$${nacos_password_hex}' USING utf8mb4)" \
          < /migrations/nacos.sql
        seata_password_hex="$$(printf '%s' "$$SEATA_DB_PASSWORD" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
        exec mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          --init-command="SET @seata_db_password = CONVERT(X'$${seata_password_hex}' USING utf8mb4)" \
          < /migrations/seata-tc.sql

  marketing-extraction-schema-init:
    image: mysql:8.4
    restart: "no"
    depends_on:
      mysql:
        condition: service_healthy
      schema-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD:?set MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD in .env}
      COUPON_DB_PASSWORD: ${COUPON_DB_PASSWORD:-}
      POINTS_DB_PASSWORD: ${POINTS_DB_PASSWORD:-}
      MEMBERSHIP_DB_PASSWORD: ${MEMBERSHIP_DB_PASSWORD:-}
      LOTTERY_DB_PASSWORD: ${LOTTERY_DB_PASSWORD:-}
      FULFILLMENT_DB_PASSWORD: ${FULFILLMENT_DB_PASSWORD:-}
    volumes:
      - ./mysql/migrations/V011__create_marketing_domain_service_databases.sql:/migrations/V011__create_marketing_domain_service_databases.sql:ro
      - ./mysql/migrations/V012__create_trade_membership_order.sql:/migrations/V012__create_trade_membership_order.sql:ro
      - ./mysql/migrations/V013__add_pay_order_domain.sql:/migrations/V013__add_pay_order_domain.sql:ro
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "-ec"]
    command:
      - |
        test -n "$$COUPON_DB_PASSWORD" || { echo "COUPON_DB_PASSWORD is required for the extracted marketing services" >&2; exit 1; }
        test -n "$$POINTS_DB_PASSWORD" || { echo "POINTS_DB_PASSWORD is required for the extracted marketing services" >&2; exit 1; }
        test -n "$$MEMBERSHIP_DB_PASSWORD" || { echo "MEMBERSHIP_DB_PASSWORD is required for the extracted marketing services" >&2; exit 1; }
        test -n "$$LOTTERY_DB_PASSWORD" || { echo "LOTTERY_DB_PASSWORD is required for the extracted marketing services" >&2; exit 1; }
        test -n "$$FULFILLMENT_DB_PASSWORD" || { echo "FULFILLMENT_DB_PASSWORD is required for the extracted marketing services" >&2; exit 1; }
        coupon_password_hex="$$(printf '%s' "$$COUPON_DB_PASSWORD" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
        points_password_hex="$$(printf '%s' "$$POINTS_DB_PASSWORD" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
        membership_password_hex="$$(printf '%s' "$$MEMBERSHIP_DB_PASSWORD" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
        lottery_password_hex="$$(printf '%s' "$$LOTTERY_DB_PASSWORD" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
        fulfillment_password_hex="$$(printf '%s' "$$FULFILLMENT_DB_PASSWORD" | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')"
        mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          --init-command="SET @hm_coupon_password = CONVERT(X'$${coupon_password_hex}' USING utf8mb4), @hm_points_password = CONVERT(X'$${points_password_hex}' USING utf8mb4), @hm_membership_password = CONVERT(X'$${membership_password_hex}' USING utf8mb4), @hm_lottery_password = CONVERT(X'$${lottery_password_hex}' USING utf8mb4), @hm_fulfillment_password = CONVERT(X'$${fulfillment_password_hex}' USING utf8mb4)" \
          < /migrations/V011__create_marketing_domain_service_databases.sql
        mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          < /migrations/V012__create_trade_membership_order.sql
        exec mysql --protocol=TCP -h mysql -uroot -p"$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD" \
          < /migrations/V013__add_pay_order_domain.sql

  nacos:
    image: nacos/nacos-server:v3.1.1
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
      - ./mysql/nacos/custom.env
    environment:
      MYSQL_SERVICE_PASSWORD: ${NACOS_DB_PASSWORD:?set NACOS_DB_PASSWORD in .env}
      NACOS_AUTH_TOKEN: ${NACOS_AUTH_TOKEN:?set NACOS_AUTH_TOKEN in .env}
      NACOS_AUTH_IDENTITY_KEY: ${NACOS_AUTH_IDENTITY_KEY:?set NACOS_AUTH_IDENTITY_KEY in .env}

CREATE TABLE coupon_template (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    template_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    template_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    coupon_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    threshold_cent BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    discount_cent BIGINT NOT NULL,
    applicable_product_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    scope_type VARCHAR(20) NULL COMMENT 'commerce scope: ALL, ITEM, CATEGORY, BRAND',
    hmall_item_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL COMMENT 'hmall.item.id for ITEM scope',
    hmall_category VARCHAR(100) NULL COMMENT 'hmall item category for CATEGORY scope',
    hmall_brand VARCHAR(100) NULL COMMENT 'hmall item brand for BRAND scope',
    valid_from DATETIME(3) NOT NULL,
    valid_until DATETIME(3) NOT NULL,
    per_user_limit INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    stackable_with_membership TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    status TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_coupon_template_code (template_code),
    KEY idx_coupon_template_hmall_item (hmall_item_id),
    KEY idx_coupon_template_hmall_category (hmall_category),
    KEY idx_coupon_template_hmall_brand (hmall_brand),
    CONSTRAINT chk_coupon_template_type CHECK (coupon_type IN ('NO_THRESHOLD','THRESHOLD')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_coupon_template_amount CHECK (threshold_cent >= 0 AND discount_cent > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_coupon_template_period CHECK (valid_until > valid_from),
    CONSTRAINT chk_coupon_template_limit CHECK (per_user_limit > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_coupon_template_status CHECK (status IN (0,1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='优惠券模板';

CREATE TABLE user_coupon (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    coupon_no VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    template_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    valid_from DATETIME(3) NOT NULL,
    valid_until DATETIME(3) NOT NULL,
    locked_order_no VARCHAR(64) NULL,
    used_order_no VARCHAR(64) NULL,
    version INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_user_coupon_no (coupon_no),
    KEY idx_user_coupon_user_status (user_id, status, valid_until, id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_user_coupon_status CHECK (status IN ('AVAILABLE','LOCKED','USED','EXPIRED')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_user_coupon_period CHECK (valid_until > valid_from)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='用户优惠券';

CREATE TABLE coupon_issue_record (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    business_no VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    template_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    user_coupon_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_coupon_issue_business (business_no),
    KEY idx_coupon_issue_user_template (user_id, template_id, id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='优惠券发放幂等记录';

# 黑马商城 × LuckyHub 融合架构 ## 1. 目标与边界 - 黑马商城继续负责：用户、商品、购物车、订单、支付和原始静态前端。 - LuckyHub 营销服务负责：活动、奖池、抽奖、积分、优惠券、会员、权益、履约、实物领奖。 - 原始 `hmall.sql` 与原始 8 张商城表不删除、不覆盖。 - 新增结构必须使用幂等增量迁移；原四个来源目录保持只读。 - LuckyHub 的 Redis Lua 配额、Redisson 锁、MySQL 条件扣库存、Outbox、Redis Stream、对账补偿链路保留。 ## 2. 运行架构 ```mermaid flowchart LR U[商城用户] --> N[Nginx 统一入口] A[商城管理员] --> N N -->|/api/marketing/**| M[marketing-service
Java 17 / Spring Boot 4] N -->|其它 /api/**| H[mall-service
黑马商城] N --> P[黑马商城静态页面
抽奖/积分/权益] H --> DB[(MySQL 8)] M --> DB M --> R[(Redis 7)] H -->|支付事务写入| O[(hmall.order_reward_outbox)] O -->|租约式幂等消费| M M -->|积分/抽奖机会/权益| LM[(luckyhub 营销表)] ``` ## 3. 身份统一 ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Browser as 浏览器 participant Mall as mall-service participant Nginx as Nginx participant Marketing as marketing-service Browser->>Mall: POST /api/users/login Mall-->>Browser: RS256 JWT(user, role) Browser->>Nginx: Authorization: Nginx->>Marketing: /api/marketing/** + 原 token Marketing->>Marketing: 只用公开证书校验签名、过期时间、user、role Marketing->>Marketing: 建立 LoginContext 与角色权限 Marketing-->>Browser: 抽奖/积分/权益结果 ``` - `role=USER`：只能访问本人的抽奖、积分、优惠券、会员和权益数据。 - `role=ADMIN`：具备活动、奖品、奖池、库存、发货等后台权限。 - 营销服务只保存公开证书，不复制黑马商城私钥。 ## 4. 高并发抽奖链路（保留 LuckyHub 原实现） ```mermaid flowchart TD Q[请求 requestId] --> LUA[Redis Lua 原子预留每日配额] LUA --> LOCK[Redisson 用户/活动锁] LOCK --> TX[MySQL 抽奖事务] TX --> STOCK{UPDATE remaining_stock
WHERE remaining_stock > 0} STOCK -->|成功| RECORD[抽奖记录 + 权益 + Outbox] STOCK -->|失败| RETRY[按剩余候选重抽] RECORD --> CONFIRM[Redis Lua 确认配额] RETRY --> CONFIRM RECORD --> STREAM[Outbox Relay → Redis Stream] STREAM --> FULFILL[幂等履约消费者] CONFIRM --> RECONCILE[超时预留/Outbox/履约对账补偿] ``` > Redis 不是奖品最终库存。Redis 负责挡流量、配额和幂等预留；MySQL 条件更新是库存最终事实。 ## 5. 数据库增量顺序 1. 原 `mysql/init/hmall.sql` 仅在全新数据卷首次初始化时执行，内容不修改。 2. `schema-init` 每次启动执行幂等商城增量： - `hmall.user.role`，默认 `USER`；演示管理员 `id=1` 为 `ADMIN`。 - `hmall.order_reward_outbox`，保存支付成功奖励事件。 - 创建 `luckyhub` 数据库与最小跨库权限。 3. `marketing-service` Flyway 在 `luckyhub` 库执行原 V1～V17 营销迁移。 4. 以后所有融合结构只新增新的版本迁移，不回写或删除原商城种子数据。 ## 6. 支付奖励一致性 商城支付成功事务必须同时完成： 1. 余额条件扣减（`amount > 0 AND balance >= amount`）。 2. 支付单 CAS 为成功。 3. 商城订单 CAS 为已支付。 4. 插入唯一事件 `ORDER_PAID:{payOrderId}` 到 `order_reward_outbox`。 营销服务按租约消费： - 领取事件：`PENDING/RETRY → PROCESSING`。 - 按支付金额发放 `ORDER_REWARD` 积分；业务号唯一，重试不重复入账。 - 可按规则额外发放抽奖机会。 - 成功标记 `DONE`；失败记录原因并指数退避，租约过期可重新领取。 ## 7. 前端入口 - 商城端：`/lottery.html`、`/points.html`、`/benefits.html`。 - 管理端：`/marketing.html`。 - 浏览器只通过 Nginx 的 `/api` 访问后端，不直接暴露内部服务地址。

    "answer": "@Transactional(isolation = Isolation.READ_COMMITTED)\npublic void grantPaidPurchase(PaySuccessMessage event) {\n    // [M04-1]：只处理不使用优惠券、金额与购买快照一致的会员支付消息。\n    if (event == null ||     "starter": "// TODO [M05-1]：补齐配置类注解与 membership.messaging.enabled 条件。\n\npublic class MembershipPayMessagingConfiguration {\n    public static final String EXCHANGE = \"pay.direct\";\n    public static final String DLX = \"pay.dlx\";\n    public static final String ROUTING_KEY = \"pay.membership.success\";\n    public static final String QUEUE = \"membership.pay.success.queue\";\n    public static final String DLQ = \"membership.pay.success.dlq\";\n\n    // TODO [M05-2]：在方法上注册 Bean。\n\n    public Declarables membershipPayTopology() {\n        // TODO [M05-3]：创建主交换机与死信交换机。\n\n        // TODO [M05-4]：创建两个队列，并配置主队列的死信交换机。\n\n        // TODO [M05-5]：创建两条绑定，返回包含全部声明的 Declarables。\n\n    }\n}",
    "answer": "// [M05-1]：仅在消息开关明确为 true 时加载拓扑配置，关闭配置方法代理。\n@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods = false)\n@ConditionalOnProperty(prefix = \"membership.messaging\", name = \"enabled\", havingValue = \"true\")\npublic class MembershipPayMessagingConfiguration {\n    public static final String EXCHANGE = \"pay.direct\";\n    public static final String DLX = \"pay.dlx\";\n    public static final String ROUTING_KEY = \"pay.membership.success\";\n    public static final String QUEUE = \"membership.pay.success.queue\";\n    public static final String DLQ = \"membership.pay.success.dlq\";\n\n    // [M05-2]：将交换机、队列与绑定作为一个可声明的 Bean 返回。\n    @Bean\n    public Declarables membershipPayTopology() {\n        // [M05-3]：两个 DirectExchange 都持久化，并且不会自动删除。\n        DirectExchange exchange = new DirectExchange(EXCHANGE, true, false);\n        DirectExchange deadLetterExchange = new DirectExchange(DLX, true, false);\n        // [M05-4]：持久化主队列设置死信交换机，死信队列也持久化。\n        Queue queue = QueueBuilder.durable(QUEUE).deadLetterExchange(DLX).build();\n        Queue deadLetterQueue = QueueBuilder.durable(DLQ).build();\n        // [M05-5]：两个队列各绑定自己的交换机，使用一致的会员支付路由键。\n        return new Declarables(exchange, deadLetterExchange, queue, deadLetterQueue,\n                BindingBuilder.bind(queue).to(exchange).with(ROUTING_KEY),\n                BindingBuilder.bind(deadLetterQueue).to(deadLetterExchange).with(ROUTING_KEY));\n    }\n}",

    "answer": "@Transactional(isolation = Isolation.READ_COMMITTED)\npublic FulfillmentTaskRecord create(CreateFulfillmentTaskCommand command) {\n    // [F01-1]：先固定 payload 快照，再计算包含请求业务内容的指纹。\n    String payload = serialize(command);\n    String fingerprint = fingerprint(command, payload);\n    // [F01-2]：同号任务已经存在时，只有指纹一致才允许作为幂等结果返回。\n    var existing = repository.findByFulfillmentNo(command.fulfillmentNo());\n    if (existing.isPresent()) {\n        return requireSameRequest(existing.get(), fingerprint);\n    }\n\n    // [F01-3]：新任务从 PENDING 和零执行次数开始，时间来自可注入时钟。\n    FulfillmentTaskRecord candidate = new FulfillmentTaskRecord(\n            null,\n            command.fulfillmentNo(),\n            command.sourceType(),\n            command.sourceId(),\n            command.fulfillmentType(),\n            command.targetUserId(),\n            payload,\n            fingerprint,\n            FulfillmentStatus.PENDING,\n            0,\n            command.maxAttempts(),\n            LocalDateTime.now(clock)\n    );\n\n    // [F01-4]：插入竞争失败时重新读同号任务，仍校验内容，查不到则抛回原异常。\n    FulfillmentTaskRecord created;\n    try {\n        created = repository.insert(candidate);\n    } catch (DuplicateFulfillmentTaskException race) {\n        return repository.findByFulfillmentNo(command.fulfillmentNo())\n                .map(task -> requireSameRequest(task, fingerprint))\n                .orElseThrow(() -> race);\n    }\n\n    // [F01-5]：仅成功创建者写就绪事件，重复请求不会重复追加。\n    outbox.appendTaskReady(created.fulfillmentNo());\n    // [F01-6]：返回 Repository 生成的已保存任务。\n    return created;\n}",

    "starter": "private Duration backoff(int attempts, Duration baseDelay, Duration maxDelay) {\n    // TODO [F02-1]：计算带指数夹限的 long 倍率。\n\n    // TODO [F02-2]：声明计算结果，并执行 Duration 乘法。\n\n    // TODO [F02-3]：完整处理 Duration 乘法的算术溢出。\n\n    // TODO [F02-4]：把正常计算或兜底结果限制到最大延迟后返回。\n\n}",
    "answer": "// 退避辅助方法只返回等待 Duration，由状态转换方法计算下一次尝试时间。\nprivate Duration backoff(int attempts, Duration baseDelay, Duration maxDelay) {\n    // [F02-1]：第 1 次按一倍等待；对指数做 0—30 夹限，使用 long 左移。\n    long multiplier = 1L << Math.min(30, Math.max(0, attempts - 1));\n    // [F02-2]：先声明结果，try 内按倍数扩大基础 Duration。\n    Duration calculated;\n    try {\n        calculated = baseDelay.multipliedBy(multiplier);\n    // [F02-3]：Duration 运算溢出时改用最大延迟，让调度仍得到确定结果。\n    } catch (ArithmeticException exception) {\n        calculated = maxDelay;\n    }\n    // [F02-4]：正常结果也可能超过上限，比较后返回较小的延迟。\n    return calculated.compareTo(maxDelay) > 0 ? maxDelay : calculated;\n}",

      "ArithmeticException 兜底覆盖 Duration 乘法溢出；正常计算后的 compareTo 负责常见的封顶情况。",

    "starter": "public FulfillmentTransition resolve(\n        GatewayOutcome outcome,\n        AttemptOperation operation,\n        int executionAttempts,\n        int maxAttempts,\n        LocalDateTime now,\n        Duration baseDelay,\n        Duration maxDelay\n) {\n    // TODO [F03-1]：准备失败分类，并建立完整的 switch 表达式。\n\n    // TODO [F03-2]：写出成功结果的状态和两个时间字段。\n\n    // TODO [F03-3]：写出结果未知时的立即对账转换。\n\n    // TODO [F03-4]：写出可重试失败的次数上限和退避两个分支。\n\n    // TODO [F03-5]：写出永久失败的隔离转换。\n\n    // TODO [F03-6]：写出 NOT_FOUND 在查询与执行下的不同转换。\n\n}",
    "answer": "public FulfillmentTransition resolve(\n        GatewayOutcome outcome,\n        AttemptOperation operation,\n        int executionAttempts,\n        int maxAttempts,\n        LocalDateTime now,\n        Duration baseDelay,\n        Duration maxDelay\n) {\n    // [F03-1]：先得到失败类别，再根据网关结果生成领域转换。\n    FailureCategory failureCategory = category(outcome);\n    return switch (outcome) {\n        // [F03-2]：成功保存完成时间，不再安排后续尝试。\n        case SUCCEEDED -> new FulfillmentTransition(FulfillmentStatus.SUCCEEDED, null, now, null);\n        // [F03-3]：未知结果进入对账，立即安排查询确认真实结果。\n        case UNKNOWN -> new FulfillmentTransition(\n                FulfillmentStatus.RECONCILING, now, null, FailureCategory.UNKNOWN);\n        // [F03-4]：可重试失败只有未达执行上限时才安排退避重试。\n        case RETRYABLE_FAILURE -> executionAttempts >= maxAttempts\n                ? new FulfillmentTransition(\n                        FulfillmentStatus.QUARANTINED, null, null, failureCategory)\n                : new FulfillmentTransition(\n                        FulfillmentStatus.RETRY_WAITING,\n                        now.plus(backoff(executionAttempts, baseDelay, maxDelay)),\n                        null,\n                        failureCategory);\n        // [F03-5]：永久失败无需继续自动尝试，直接进入隔离状态。\n        case PERMANENT_FAILURE -> new FulfillmentTransition(\n                FulfillmentStatus.QUARANTINED, null, null, failureCategory);\n        // [F03-6]：查询未找到可回到待执行；执行未找到则先按退避等待。\n        case NOT_FOUND -> operation == AttemptOperation.QUERY\n                ? new FulfillmentTransition(FulfillmentStatus.PENDING, now, null, null)\n                : new FulfillmentTransition(\n                        FulfillmentStatus.RETRY_WAITING,\n                        now.plus(backoff(executionAttempts, baseDelay, maxDelay)),\n                        null,\n                        null);\n    };\n}",
    "explanation": [
      "UNKNOWN 代表远程结果未确定，进入 RECONCILING 后通过查询确认，不能直接当作失败再次发放。",
      "完成时间只在 SUCCEEDED 中写 now；等待重试、对账和隔离都不伪造成功完成时间。",
      "可重试失败按已发生的 executionAttempts 与 maxAttempts 比较，不在转换方法里再增加次数。",
      "NOT_FOUND 的判断取决于当前操作；原实现的 NOT_FOUND 分支不应用可重试失败的次数上限条件，练习不要擅自合并这两类结果。"
    ],
    "checks": [
      "SUCCEEDED + EXECUTE：状态 SUCCEEDED，completedAt=now，nextAttemptAt 和 failureCategory 为空。",
      "UNKNOWN + EXECUTE：状态 RECONCILING，nextAttemptAt=now，failureCategory=UNKNOWN。",
      "RETRYABLE_FAILURE、executionAttempts=1、maxAttempts=5、baseDelay=2s、maxDelay=5s：状态 RETRY_WAITING，下次时间 now+2s。",
      "RETRYABLE_FAILURE、executionAttempts=5、maxAttempts=5：状态 QUARANTINED，没有下次时间。",
      "PERMANENT_FAILURE：状态 QUARANTINED，失败类别 PERMANENT。",
      "NOT_FOUND + QUERY，即使 executionAttempts=5 且 maxAttempts=5：状态 PENDING，下次时间 now；NOT_FOUND + EXECUTE、executionAttempts=2、baseDelay=1s：下次时间 now+2s。"
    ],
    "language": "java"

    "answer": "@Transactional\npublic FulfillmentTaskView retryQuarantined(String fulfillmentNo, long operatorId, String note) {\n    // [F04-1]：先统一履约号格式，再检查有效操作人。\n    String normalized = requiredFulfillmentNo(fulfillmentNo);\n    requireOperator(operatorId);\n    // [F04-2]：锁住任务状态，避免同一任务的人工操作相互穿插。\n    var task = repository.lockByFulfillmentNo(normalized)\n            .orElseThrow(() -> new FulfillmentTaskNotFoundException(normalized));\n    // [F04-3]：只有已隔离任务可以使用本操作恢复执行。\n    if (task.status() != FulfillmentStatus.QUARANTINED) {\n        throw new FulfillmentTaskOperationNotAllowedException(\"RETRY\", task.status());\n    }\n    // [F04-4]：必须恰好更新一条任务，否则按操作冲突处理。\n    if (repository.retryQuarantined(task.id()) != 1) {\n        throw new FulfillmentTaskOperationConflictException(task.id());\n    }\n    // [F04-5]：记录本次人工处理，并在同一事务中写就绪事件。\n    repository.resolveQuarantine(task.id(), \"RETRY\", operatorId, safeNote(note));\n    outbox.appendTaskReady(normalized);\n    // [F04-6]：返回数据库中的最新任务视图。\n    return tasks.get(normalized);\n}",

    "answer": "    private PointsLedgerView mutate(ValidMutation mutation, PointsDirection direction) {\n        // [P01-1] 确认用户可用，幂等创建积分账户，并查找该业务键已有流水。\n        requireEnabledUser(mutation.userId());\n        accountMapper.ensureAccount(mutation.userId());\n        PointsLedger existing = findLedger(mutation.businessType(), mutation.businessId());\n        // [P01-2] 已有流水必须与本次用户、业务、方向和金额一致，匹配时直接返回。\n        if (existing != null) {\n            validateLedger(existing, mutation, direction);\n            return view(existing);\n        }\n\n        // [P01-3] 按方向执行原子余额更新；入账溢出或扣账余额不足时抛出对应错误。\n        int updated = direction == PointsDirection.CREDIT\n                ? accountMapper.creditIfNoOverflow(mutation.userId(), mutation.amount())\n                : accountMapper.debitIfSufficient(mutation.userId(), mutation.amount());\n        if (updated != 1) {\n            throw error(direction == PointsDirection.CREDIT\n                    ? """Build a self-contained, UTF-8 practice page using only the Python standard library."""

import json
import re
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
SERVICES = ["lottery", "points", "coupon", "membership", "fulfillment"]
PREFIXES = {"lottery": "L", "points": "P", "coupon": "C", "membership": "M", "fulfillment": "F"}


def load_questions():
    questions = []
    required = {
        "id", "service", "title", "level", "minutes", "tags", "purpose", "component",
        "sources", "scope", "context", "requirements", "starter", "answer", "explanation",
        "checks", "language",
    }
    for path in sorted((HERE / "bank").glob("*.json")):
        records = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        assert isinstance(records, list), f"{path}: expected question array"
        questions.extend(records)
    assert len(questions) == 25, f"Expected 25 exercises, got {len(questions)}"
    assert len({q["id"] for q in questions}) == len(questions), "Duplicate question IDs"
    counts = Counter(q["service"] for q in questions)
    assert counts == Counter({service: 5 for service in SERVICES}), counts
    steps = 0
    for question in questions:
        assert required <= question.keys(), f"{question.get('id')}: missing fields"
        qid = question["id"]
        assert re.fullmatch(PREFIXES[question["service"]] + r"0[1-5]", qid), qid
        assert question["language"] in {"java", "yaml", "lua"}, qid
        assert question["level"] in {"基础", "进阶", "综合"}, qid
        for field in ["tags", "context", "requirements", "explanation", "checks"]:
            assert isinstance(question[field], list) and question[field], (qid, field)
            assert all(isinstance(item, str) and item.strip() for item in question[field]), (qid, field)
        for field in ["title", "purpose", "component", "scope", "starter", "answer"]:
            assert isinstance(question[field], str) and question[field].strip(), (qid, field)
        todo_ids = re.findall(r"TODO\s+\[([^\]]+)\]", question["starter"])
        assert len(todo_ids) >= 3, f"{qid}: expected whole-step writing positions"
        assert len(todo_ids) == len(set(todo_ids)), f"{qid}: duplicate step IDs"
        assert all(step.startswith(qid + "-") for step in todo_ids), f"{qid}: wrong step ID"
        assert "TODO [" not in question["answer"], f"{qid}: unfinished answer"
        steps += len(todo_ids)
        assert question["sources"], f"{qid}: no source"
        for source in question["sources"]:
            source_path = (ROOT / source["path"]).resolve()
            assert source_path.is_relative_to(ROOT) and source_path.is_file(), (qid, source)
            lines = source_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines()
            assert isinstance(source["line"], int) and 1 <= source["line"] <= len(lines), (qid, source)
            assert source["path"].split("/")[0] == question["service"] + "-service", (qid, source)
            assert source["symbol"].strip(), (qid, source)
    questions.sort(key=lambda q: (SERVICES.index(q["service"]), q["id"]))
    return questions, counts, steps


def main():
    questions, counts, steps = load_questions()
    data = json.dumps({"sourceRoot": ROOT.as_posix(), "questions": questions}, ensure_ascii=False)
    # Escape HTML-significant characters before embedding data in a script element.
    for character, escaped in [("<", "\\u003c"), (">", "\\u003e"), ("&", "\\u0026"), ("\u2028", "\\u2028"), ("\u2029", "\\u2029")]:
        data = data.replace(character, escaped)
    page = (HERE / "web-shell.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    page = page.replace("{{STYLES}}", (HERE / "web-style.css").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    page = page.replace("{{APP}}", (HERE / "web-app.js").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    page = page.replace("{{DATA}}", data)
    assert not any(marker in page for marker in ["{{STYLES}}", "{{APP}}", "{{DATA}}"])
    (HERE / "index.html").write_text(page, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Built index.html: {len(questions)} exercises, {steps} whole-step writing positions; {dict(counts)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# HMall 五个微服务代码练习

这份题库用于熟悉一个已有项目：先读清楚一段代码负责的功能，再根据中文步骤补全关键代码，最后对照答案解释自己的选择。

第一版是 **12 道样例题**，用于确认练习形式。入口是 [第一组：题目与答案](01-five-services.md)。题目在前，完整参考答案集中在文档后半部分。

## 五个服务分别负责什么

| 服务 | 主要工作 | 第一版对应题目 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cart-service` | 维护用户购物车，查询时补充商品最新信息 | Q01、Q02 |
| `item-service` | 商品增删改查、分页、库存扣减 | Q03、Q04、Q06 |
| `user-service` | 登录、校验密码、生成登录令牌 | Q05 |
| `trade-service` | 维护业务订单，处理支付成功后的订单状态 | Q07 |
| `pay-service` | 管理支付单，将支付成功事件写入 Outbox | Q08 |

Q09、Q10 练习这些服务使用的公共组件和配置。Q11、Q12 从仓库中的 `lottery-service` 补充 Redis 和 Redisson 练习；它们不是上述五个服务已有的购物车缓存功能。

## 先练哪一题

先做 **Q01：查看我的购物车**。它完整展示了本题库的主要形式：功能说明 → 真实文件路径 → 现有上下文 → 分步骤填空 → 自查场景 → 文档后面的答案。

推荐顺序：Q01 → Q02 → Q03 → Q04 → Q05 → Q06 → Q07 → Q08 → Q09 → Q10 → Q11 → Q12。前五题偏基础，后面逐步涉及并发、事务、配置和 Redis。

## 怎么填写

1. 打开题目，先读“该部分是完成什么工作”和“已提供的上下文”。
2. 在文档的代码块中替换 `__Q01_01__` 这样的占位符，或者把代码复制到自己的练习副本中填写。占位符前面的中文注释就是步骤提示。
3. 一个占位符可能代表一个表达式、一条语句或一段注解。题目已经写好的括号、引号、分号需要保留。
4. 填完后先用“自查场景”检查思路，再打开对应答案。写法可以不同，但查询范围、返回结果、状态约束等行为要一致。
5. 对照原文件继续看调用关系，练习用自己的话说明为什么要这样写。

这些练习代码是从现有类中抽取的方法或配置片段，**不是独立可运行的 Java 项目**。题目会列出类成员、辅助方法和导入来源。想在 IDE 中运行时，应在练习副本中保留原类的包名、导入、继承关系和其余方法，再替换题目对应片段。

题库放在 `docs/practice`，不参与 Maven 编译。业务源码没有为练习改成填空版本。

## 一个题目固定包含什么

```text

练习代码：
1. 中文注释，说明这一小步要完成什么
   留出代码填写位置

自查场景：输入、预期结果、需要考虑的边界

```

## 组件与练习主题对照

| 组件或机制 | 这份题库里的主题功能 |
| --- | --- |
| MyBatis-Plus | 简化数据库增删改查，将分页结果转换成接口返回值 |
| OpenFeign + Nacos | 按服务名调用商品服务；Nacos 提供注册发现和外部配置 |
| BCrypt + JWT | 校验密码摘要，生成带有效期的登录令牌 |
| MySQL 条件 UPDATE | 让“库存足够”和“扣库存”在一条 SQL 中执行，处理并发扣减 |
| MySQL `FOR UPDATE` | 在数据库事务中锁住订单记录，协调重复支付回调 |
| Spring 事务 + Seata AT | 管理本地数据库事务，以及接入同一 XID 的跨服务数据库事务 |
| Outbox + RabbitMQ | 先在业务事务中保存待发送事件，再由现有 relay 投递消息 |
| `@ConfigurationProperties` | 把 YAML 配置绑定成 Java 对象，供业务类使用 |
| Redis + Lua | 原子处理抽奖次数检查、预占和重复请求 |
| Redisson `RLock` | 按活动和用户协调多个服务实例的抽奖操作 |

第一版聚焦这些机制在当前项目中的实际用途，没有覆盖每个服务的所有功能。

## 不能跳过的现状与风险

- Marketing `JwtService.generate()` 使用 HS256，但 `JwtService.parse()` 调用只验证 RS256 的 `HmallJwtService`。新营销兼容登录必须由 `user-service` 签发 Gateway 与旧 Marketing 服务都能验证的 RS256 token，并测试 `user`、`role`、过期时间与会话 `jti`。
- 登录 JSON 也不同：Marketing 返回 `LoginView(userId, username, nickname, token, tokenType, expiresIn)` 并用 `ApiResponse` 包装；商城当前返回 `UserLoginVO(userId, username, balance, token)`。
- Marketing session Redis 协议为 `luckyhub:auth:session:{sessionId}`，值为用户 ID 字符串，TTL 等于 token TTL；RBAC 权限缓存为 `rbac:permissions:user:{userId}`，TTL 10 分钟。损坏缓存删除后回源、Redis 读失败按未命中回源、空集合缓存、权限变更即时及提交后再次失效都须保留。`SessionService.isValid` 当前没有生产调用点，不应借迁移顺手改变 token 校验语义。
- `luckyhub.sys_user` 与 `hm_user.user` 字段和状态值不同：前者有 `nickname`、状态 0/1；后者有 `phone`、`balance`、`role`、无 `nickname`，状态正常/冻结为 1/2。两库 ID/用户名冲突必须先出报告，禁止仅凭同名或相同 ID 自动合并。
- Marketing `sys_user` 仍被抽奖机会、积分、优惠券等业务使用。`HmallUserProjectionServiceImpl` 还负责建立 `hmall:{userId}` 投影、补默认角色并幂等发放结算券。移动 auth/RBAC 时需要替换这些耦合，不能直接删表或丢掉券发放效果。
- 共享安全边界仍需保留两种现有上下文语义：`hm-api` 和 `user-service` 使用 `mall-backend/hm-common` 的 `UserContext`；Marketing 使用包含 `userId/username/sessionId/role` 的 `LoginContext`。Marketing `AuthenticationFilter` 除解析 token 外，还调用 `HmallUserProjectionService.ensureActiveHmallUser`；抽取 `hm-security` 或调整过滤器时必须明确保留此投影/幂等发券职责和当前权限解析语义，不能借机绕过身份审计。
- 抽奖 Redis Lua 配额状态机、`draw:reservation:*`、`lock:draw:{activityId}:{userId}` Redisson 锁和 timeout 对账完全未触碰；后续 `lottery-service` 迁移必须按批准设计原样继承。

from pathlib import Path
import unittest
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
NS = {"m": "http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"}


def pom(path: str) -> ET.Element:
    return ET.parse(ROOT / path).getroot()


def text(node: ET.Element, path: str) -> str | None:
    found = node.find(path, NS)
    return found.text.strip() if found is not None and found.text else None


class HmApiContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_reactor_contains_hm_api_before_cart(self):
        modules = [n.text.strip() for n in pom("pom.xml").findall("m:modules/m:module", NS)]
        self.assertIn("hm-api", modules)
        self.assertLess(modules.index("hm-api"), modules.index("cart-service"))

    def test_hm_api_matches_hmall_java_11_baseline(self):
        api = pom("hm-api/pom.xml")
        parent = api.find("m:parent", NS)
        self.assertEqual("com.heima", text(parent, "m:groupId"))
        self.assertEqual("hmall", text(parent, "m:artifactId"))
        self.assertEqual("1.0.0", text(parent, "m:version"))
        self.assertEqual("../mall-backend/pom.xml", text(parent, "m:relativePath"))
        self.assertEqual("hm-api", text(api, "m:artifactId"))
        self.assertEqual("11", text(api, "m:properties/m:java.version"))

    def test_hm_api_is_a_non_runnable_openfeign_contract_jar(self):
        api = pom("hm-api/pom.xml")
        dependencies = {
            (text(n, "m:groupId"), text(n, "m:artifactId"))
            for n in api.findall("m:dependencies/m:dependency", NS)
        }
        self.assertEqual({("org.springframework.cloud", "spring-cloud-starter-openfeign")}, dependencies)
        self.assertIsNone(api.find("m:build/m:plugins/m:plugin", NS))
        self.assertFalse((ROOT / "hm-api/src/main/java/com/dongqh/hmapi/HmApiApplication.java").exists())
        self.assertFalse((ROOT / "hm-api/src/main/resources/application.yaml").exists())

    def test_contract_does_not_reference_cart_service(self):
        client = (ROOT / "hm-api/src/main/java/com/dongqh/hmapi/client/ItemClient.java").read_text("utf-8")
        self.assertIn("com.dongqh.hmapi.dto.ItemDTO", client)
        self.assertNotIn("cartservice", client)

    def test_cart_consumes_hm_api_without_duplicate_contracts(self):
        cart = pom("cart-service/pom.xml")

            for n in cart.findall("m:dependencies/m:dependency", NS)
        }
        self.assertIn(("com.heima", "hm-api"), dependencies)
        self.assertFalse((ROOT / "cart-service/src/main/java/com/dongqh/cartservice/client/ItemClient.java").exists())
        self.assertFalse((ROOT / "cart-service/src/main/java/com/dongqh/cartservice/domain/dto/ItemDTO.java").exists())
        app = (ROOT / "cart-service/src/main/java/com/dongqh/cartservice/CartServiceApplication.java").read_text("utf-8")
        self.assertIn('basePackages = "com.dongqh.hmapi.client"', app)

# Hmall Five-Service Runtime Cutover Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Make `item-service`, `cart-service`, `user-service`, `trade-service`, and `pay-service` the default Black Mall runtime without losing any frontend behavior, while keeping the monolith as an explicit rollback profile and preparing the shared contracts for later LuckyHub extraction.

**Architecture:** Nginx owns path routing and sends each Black Mall API prefix directly to its owning service. All five Java 11/Spring Boot 2.7 services register with Nacos and use OpenFeign contracts from the pure Java 11 `hm-api` JAR. Each service connects only to its own MySQL database. `marketing-service` remains Java 17/Spring Boot 4 during this phase and continues to use the current HTTP integration until its three-service extraction begins.

**Tech Stack:** Java 11, Spring Boot 2.7.12, Spring Cloud 2021.0.3, Spring Cloud Alibaba 2021.0.4.0, OpenFeign, Nacos, MyBatis-Plus, MySQL 8.4, Redis 7.4, Docker Compose, Nginx, Python `unittest` contract tests, JUnit 5/Mockito.

## Global Constraints

- Preserve every existing user change in the dirty worktree; stage and commit only the files named by the current task.
- Do not modify or renumber existing SQL migrations `V001` through `V008` or LuckyHub Flyway migrations `V1` through `V25`.
- Keep Black Mall modules on Java 11/Spring Boot 2.7 and `marketing-service` on Java 17/Spring Boot 4.
- Keep `hm-api` free of persistence, Swagger/Knife4j, web-server, and implementation dependencies.
- Do not introduce direct database access across services; all cross-service calls go through `hm-api` OpenFeign clients.
- Keep secrets in environment variables. `.env.example` contains safe placeholders only.
- Run each red test before implementation and record that it failed for the intended reason.
- Because `mall-backend/hm-service/target` predates this plan, do not delete it without user approval; run focused verification separately from the workspace-layout guard.

```python
from pathlib import Path
import re
import unittest
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
NS = {"m": "http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"}
MODULES = (
    "mall-backend", "item-service", "hm-api", "cart-service",
    "user-service", "trade-service", "pay-service", "marketing-service",
    "hm-gateway",
)


def read(path: str) -> str:
    return (ROOT / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")


class Java17Boot4UpgradeContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_root_owns_the_platform_and_all_modules(self):
        root = ET.parse(ROOT / "pom.xml").getroot()
        parent = root.find("m:parent", NS)
        self.assertEqual("org.springframework.boot", parent.findtext("m:groupId", namespaces=NS))
        self.assertEqual("spring-boot-starter-parent", parent.findtext("m:artifactId", namespaces=NS))
        self.assertEqual("4.0.8", parent.findtext("m:version", namespaces=NS))
        self.assertEqual("17", root.findtext("m:properties/m:java.version", namespaces=NS))
        modules = [node.text.strip() for node in root.findall("m:modules/m:module", NS)]
        self.assertEqual(set(MODULES), set(modules))

    def test_platform_versions_are_single_sourced(self):
        root = read("pom.xml")
        self.assertIn("<spring-cloud.version>2025.1.0</spring-cloud.version>", root)
        self.assertIn("<spring-cloud-alibaba.version>2025.1.0.0</spring-cloud-alibaba.version>", root)
        self.assertIn("<mybatis-plus.version>3.5.17</mybatis-plus.version>", root)
        self.assertIn("<springdoc.version>3.0.3</springdoc.version>", root)
        for pom in ROOT.rglob("pom.xml"):
            if pom == ROOT / "pom.xml":
                continue
            source = pom.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertNotRegex(source, r"<java.version>11</java.version>", str(pom))
            self.assertNotIn("mybatis-plus-boot-starter", source, str(pom))
            self.assertNotIn("knife4j-openapi2-spring-boot-starter", source, str(pom))
            self.assertNotIn("spring-cloud-starter-bootstrap", source, str(pom))

    def test_java_ee_imports_use_jakarta(self):
        offenders = []
        for java in ROOT.rglob("*.java"):
            source = java.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            if re.search(r"import javax\.(servlet|validation)\.", source):
                offenders.append(str(java.relative_to(ROOT)))
        self.assertEqual([], offenders)

    def test_all_java_dockerfiles_use_temurin_17(self):
        dockerfiles = [
            "mall-backend/hm-service/Dockerfile", "item-service/Dockerfile",
            "cart-service/Dockerfile", "user-service/Dockerfile",
            "trade-service/Dockerfile", "pay-service/Dockerfile",
            "marketing-service/Dockerfile",
        ]
        for path in dockerfiles:
            with self.subTest(path=path):
                source = read(path)
                self.assertIn("eclipse-temurin-17", source)
                self.assertIn("eclipse-temurin:17-jre", source)
                self.assertNotIn("temurin-11", source)

    def test_boot4_auto_configuration_registration_exists(self):
        imports = "mall-backend/hm-common/src/main/resources/META-INF/spring/org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfiguration.imports"
        self.assertTrue((ROOT / imports).is_file())
        source = read(imports)
        for name in ("MyBatisConfig", "MvcConfig", "JsonConfig", "OpenApiAutoConfiguration"):
            self.assertIn(name, source)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import unittest


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SEATA_SQL = ROOT / "mysql" / "seata" / "seata-tc.sql"


def read(relative_path: str) -> str:
    return (ROOT / relative_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def compose_config() -> dict:
    result = subprocess.run(
        [
            "docker", "compose", "--env-file", str(ROOT / ".env.example"),
            "-f", str(ROOT / "compose.yaml"), "config", "--format", "json",
        ],
        cwd=ROOT,
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise AssertionError(
            f"docker compose config failed:\n{result.stdout}\n{result.stderr}"
        )
    return json.loads(result.stdout)


class SeataDatabaseContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.sql = SEATA_SQL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        cls.normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", cls.sql).lower()

    def test_database_and_dedicated_user_are_provisioned_repeatably(self):
        self.assertRegex(
            self.normalized,
            r"create database if not exists\s+`?seata`?.*character set\s+utf8mb4",
        )
        self.assertIn("create user if not exists 'seata_app'@'%'", self.normalized)
        self.assertIn("alter user ''seata_app''@''%'' identified by", self.normalized)
        self.assertRegex(
            self.normalized,
            r"grant\s+select\s*,\s*insert\s*,\s*update\s*,\s*delete\s+on\s+`?seata`?\.\*\s+to\s+'seata_app'@'%'",
        )
        self.assertNotRegex(
            self.normalized,
            r"grant\s+all privileges.*'seata_app'",
        )

    def test_all_tc_tables_and_distributed_locks_are_idempotent(self):
        for table in (
            "global_table",
            "branch_table",
            "lock_table",
            "distributed_lock",
        ):
            with self.subTest(table=table):
                self.assertRegex(
                    self.normalized,
                    rf"create table if not exists\s+`?{table}`?",
                )
        self.assertEqual(4, len(re.findall(r"insert ignore into\s+`?distributed_lock`?", self.normalized)))

    def test_schema_init_mounts_and_executes_seata_sql_with_injected_password(self):
        service = compose_config()["services"]["schema-init"]
        mounts = {
            mount["target"]: mount for mount in service["volumes"]
        }
        self.assertIn("/migrations/seata-tc.sql", mounts)
        self.assertTrue(mounts["/migrations/seata-tc.sql"]["read_only"])
        self.assertIn("SEATA_DB_PASSWORD", service["environment"])
        command = " ".join(
            service["command"]
            if isinstance(service["command"], list)
            else [service["command"]]
        )
        self.assertIn("SET @seata_db_password", command)
        self.assertIn("/migrations/seata-tc.sql", command)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

# Fulfillment Task RabbitMQ Trigger Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Make RabbitMQ the primary trigger for newly created fulfillment tasks while preserving the database task state machine and reducing the scheduler to compensation work.

**Architecture:** A task creation or manual retry transaction writes a dedicated `fulfillment_outbox` row. A lease-based relay publishes `FulfillmentTaskReadyEvent` through correlated confirms to `fulfillment.direct/fulfillment.task.ready`; the queue consumer atomically claims that one database task, then executes the existing synchronous gateway/state transition flow outside the claim transaction. A grace-aware scheduler remains responsible only for missed pending notifications, due retries/reconciliation, and expired leases.

**Tech Stack:** Java 17, Spring Boot 4.0.8, Spring AMQP 4, MyBatis-Plus, MySQL 8/Flyway, JUnit 5, AssertJ, Mockito.

## Global Constraints

- Keep `fulfillment_task`, `fulfillment_attempt`, and `fulfillment_quarantine` as the authoritative state machine and audit data.
- Publish to durable direct exchange `fulfillment.direct` with routing key `fulfillment.task.ready`.
- Consume from `marketing.fulfillment.execute.queue`; dead-letter exhausted listener failures to `marketing.fulfillment.execute.dlq` through `fulfillment.dlx`.
- Keep coupon, points, membership, and logistics gateway calls synchronous and outside database transactions.
- Keep admin create, read, page, retry, and terminate HTTP contracts synchronous and unchanged.
- Do not modify post-success benefit projection; preserve the existing logistics projection call only.
- Use a dedicated `fulfillment_outbox`; do not generalize or change the lottery `message_outbox` pipeline.
- Continue using virtual host `/dongqh`, the existing `JacksonJsonMessageConverter`, and `luckyhub.messaging.enabled`.
- Use PowerShell 7 commands and UTF-8 for all repository work.

# Trade Cart Cleanup RabbitMQ Migration Plan

## Scope

Replace only the synchronous cart cleanup performed after a trade order is created. Keep address, catalog, stock, coupon, membership and payment calls synchronous because their results affect the current request.

## Design

- Persist an `ORDER_CREATED` message in a trade outbox in the same transaction as the order.
- Relay due outbox rows to durable topic exchange `trade.events.topic` with routing key `trade.order.created` and publisher confirms.
- Consume from durable queue `cart.trade.order-created.queue` in cart-service.
- Retry listener failures three times, then dead-letter to `cart.trade.order-created.dlq` through `trade.events.dlx`.
- Delete only cart rows owned by the event user whose `update_time` is not later than the event timestamp, making redelivery idempotent and preserving items re-added after checkout.

## Verification

- Unit-test order creation appends the event and no longer calls CartClient.
- Unit-test publisher confirms/returns and outbox retry state transitions.
- Unit-test listener delegation and cutoff-aware cart deletion.
- Compile affected modules and run their focused regression suites.
- Verify the topology against the real `/dongqh` RabbitMQ vhost.

```python
import re
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


SQL_PATH = (
    Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    / "scripts"
    / "migration"
    / "marketing-catalog-inventory-preflight.sql"
)


class MarketingCatalogInventoryPreflightTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.sql = SQL_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        cls.sql_without_comments = re.sub(
            r"/\*.*?\*/|--[^\r\n]*|\#[^\r\n]*",
            "",
            cls.sql,
            flags=re.DOTALL,
        )
        cls.statements = [
            statement.strip()
            for statement in cls.sql_without_comments.split(";")
            if statement.strip()
        ]

    def test_script_contains_only_select_statements(self):
        self.assertTrue(self.statements)
        for statement in self.statements:
            self.assertRegex(statement, r"(?is)^SELECT\b")
            self.assertNotRegex(
                statement,
                r"(?i)\b(ALTER|CREATE|DELETE|DROP|GRANT|INSERT|RENAME|REPLACE|REVOKE|TRUNCATE|UPDATE|USE)\b",
            )

    def test_script_never_selects_all_columns_or_row_level_mapping(self):
        self.assertNotRegex(self.sql_without_comments, r"(?i)\bSELECT\s+\*")
        self.assertNotRegex(
            self.sql_without_comments,
            r"(?i)\b(product_name|sku_name|sku_code|business_no|username|phone|password_hash)\b",
        )

    def test_script_reports_required_aggregate_domains(self):
        for token in (
            "luckyhub.product",
            "luckyhub.product_sku",
            "luckyhub.sku_inventory",
            "luckyhub.inventory_channel_stock",
            "luckyhub.inventory_reservation",
            "luckyhub.inventory_ledger",
            "hmall.item",
            "information_schema.columns",
            "COUNT(*)",
        ):
            with self.subTest(token=token):
                self.assertIn(token, self.sql_without_comments)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

在 `tests/test_marketing_identity_rbac_preflight.py` 中使用 `unittest` 和 `pathlib` 加载 SQL 文件，增加以下断言：

```python
import re
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


class MarketingIdentityRbacPreflightTests(unittest.TestCase):
    script_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts/migration/marketing-identity-rbac-preflight.sql"

    def test_script_exists_and_checks_both_identity_databases(self):
        sql = self.script_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("luckyhub.sys_user", sql)
        self.assertIn("hm_user.user", sql)
        self.assertIn("information_schema.columns", sql)

    def test_script_contains_only_read_queries(self):
        sql = re.sub(r"(?m)^\s*--.*$", "", self.script_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        sql = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", sql, flags=re.S)
        self.assertNotRegex(sql, r"(?i)\b(INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|REPLACE|ALTER|CREATE|DROP|TRUNCATE|RENAME|CALL)\b")

    def test_script_reports_identity_and_rbac_conflicts_without_selecting_passwords(self):
        sql = self.script_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").lower()
        for required in ("username", "sys_user_role", "sys_role_permission", "status", "password regexp"):
            self.assertIn(required, sql)
        self.assertNotRegex(sql, r"(?is)select\s+[^;]*\bpassword\s*(,|from)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

from pathlib import Path
import re
import unittest


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SQL_PATH = ROOT / "scripts/migration/marketing-trade-pay-preflight.sql"


class MarketingTradePayPreflightTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def read_sql(self) -> str:
        return SQL_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    def statements(self) -> list[str]:
        sql = self.read_sql()
        sql = re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/|--[^\n]*|#[^\n]*", "", sql, flags=re.S)
        return [statement.strip() for statement in sql.split(";") if statement.strip()]

    def test_every_statement_is_a_read_only_select(self):
        statements = self.statements()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(statements), 8)
        forbidden = re.compile(
            r"\b(INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|REPLACE|CREATE|ALTER|DROP|TRUNCATE|GRANT|REVOKE|"
            r"CALL|PREPARE|EXECUTE|LOCK\s+TABLES|INTO\s+(OUTFILE|DUMPFILE)|FOR\s+UPDATE)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )
        for statement in statements:
            self.assertRegex(statement, r"(?is)^SELECT\b")
            self.assertIsNone(forbidden.search(statement), statement)

    def test_queries_use_explicit_source_and_target_schemas(self):
        sql = self.read_sql().lower()
        for table in (
            "luckyhub.mall_order",
            "luckyhub.payment_order",
            "hm_trade.",
            "hm_pay.pay_order",
            "hm_pay.pay_message_outbox",
            "information_schema.",
        ):
            self.assertIn(table, sql)

    def test_queries_never_select_row_level_payment_or_personal_fields(self):

        self.assertNotRegex(sql, r"(?is)\bSELECT\s+\*")
        for field in ("username", "phone", "mobile", "password", "credential", "signature"):
            self.assertNotRegex(sql, rf"(?i)\b{field}\b")
        self.assertNotRegex(sql, r"(?is)SELECT\s+(?:p\.)?payment_no\b")
        self.assertNotRegex(sql, r"(?is)SELECT\s+(?:o\.)?order_no\b")

    def test_required_aggregate_result_aliases_and_server_version_exist(self):

            "orphan_payment_count",
            "payment_amount_mismatch_count",
            "trade_order_total",
            "pay_order_total",
        ):
            self.assertIn(alias, sql)
        self.assertRegex(sql, r"(?is)select\s+version\(\)\s+as\s+mysql_server_version")

# Marketing Membership Service Compatibility-First Extraction Plan

> This is a gated implementation plan, not authorization to start the migration. Do not execute implementation tasks until every applicable gate below has evidence and the relevant contract decisions are approved.

**Goal:** Extract Marketing membership into the already-approved `membership-service` boundary while preserving current membership reads and benefit snapshots, separating verified paid purchases from reward grants, and ensuring one writer at every stage.

**Architecture:** `membership-service` becomes the sole owner of `membership_product`, `user_membership`, and `membership_grant_record` in `hm_membership`. Preserve the existing `/api/memberships/**` public contract during transition. Keep the old Marketing implementation as the sole writer until an explicit, validated cutover; never dual-write. Consumers use provider APIs/events rather than Membership mappers or cross-schema SQL. Trade/Pay own cash purchase and payment verification; Lottery/Fulfillment own reward eligibility and successful fulfillment; Membership applies an idempotent grant only after the corresponding authoritative event/command.

**Tech Stack:** Java 17, Spring Boot 4, MyBatis-Plus, Flyway, existing `hm-api` DTO/client conventions, RabbitMQ durable payment/fulfillment events, JUnit 5/Mockito, and isolated test databases. Production database access is not part of plan preparation.

## Global Constraints

- Preserve existing workspace changes and every untracked file; do not reset, clean, replace, or stage unrelated work.
- Keep the preflight status `未运行` unless an already-existing account is confirmed to have only `SELECT` privileges and access to all required schemas. Never create or modify DB accounts, use unknown application credentials, or infer a clean result from unavailable data.
- A database identity audit that reports any identity ambiguity, `hmall:{id}` projection anomaly, or RBAC orphan blocks user-keyed membership migration. Record only sanitized aggregates; do not place usernames, phone numbers, password hashes, credentials, or row-level account maps in Git/docs/handoff.
- Do not start Compose, schema-init, applications, or other stateful services as part of readiness work. Do not rewrite Marketing Flyway V1–V28; the new service begins with its own `hm_membership` migration history only after the data plan is approved.
- Do not switch Gateway/Nginx login or RBAC routes, modify account data, remove current Marketing membership/RBAC code, or begin `user-service` identity/RBAC migration in this plan-preparation task.
- Do not let the new service read/lock `sys_user`, copy RBAC tables, or claim a remote status check is equivalent to the existing same-transaction `FOR UPDATE` lock.
- Do not change Lottery Redis Lua, quota keys, Redisson locks, TTLs, or reconciliation behavior.
- Do not call the migration complete until module, data, API, authorization, consumer, rollback, and no-old-writer checks all pass. The target is one of the five planned Marketing replacements; this plan does not claim all ten business services exist.

## Hard Gates Before Implementation

1. **Identity and RBAC evidence:** Execute the existing identity/RBAC aggregate preflight only after the read-only credential and schema-access conditions are verified. Reconcile the approved stable user identifier and permission-enforcement path. Any ambiguity or orphan stops user-keyed membership migration; no automatic ID repair, account merge, or permission copy is allowed.
2. **Paid purchase authorization:** Define how Membership can establish that a purchase is paid from a durable, authoritative Pay event. Approve event identity, order domain/reference, user ID, product reference, replay behavior, and rejection behavior. The current public `POST /api/memberships/purchases` accepts a caller-provided `businessNo` and product ID and does not show Trade/Pay paid-state verification; it cannot be treated as a verified purchase command without a separately approved contract.
3. **Reward grant authorization:** Specify a grant path distinct from paid purchase. `fulfillment-service` may invoke it only after validating the reward task identity/snapshot and before reporting fulfillment success. It must carry an immutable product reference and use a tested idempotency key. Preserve `fulfillmentNo-M-index` only if the approved contract confirms stability, uniqueness, and length.
4. **Membership time semantics:** Decide whether `user_membership.starts_at` means first-ever activation or the start of the currently effective membership. Existing renewal and level-change code does not update this field for an existing row, and current tests do not settle that meaning. Preserve observed behavior until an explicit decision is approved.
5. **Product identity and snapshot contract:** Resolve whether Lottery’s numeric `rewardTargetId` remains a stable Membership product ID or is replaced with an approved immutable code/reference. Confirm that reward-definition validation, snapshot creation, fulfillment payload, grant request, and replay all refer to the same product even after data migration.
6. **User deactivation/concurrency semantics:** Approve what happens if a user is disabled while a payment or reward grant is in flight. The existing membership transaction locks `sys_user`; the new service cannot reproduce that cross-service lock. Define and test the replacement consistency rule before writes move.
7. **Authorization compatibility:** Define how existing `MEMBERSHIP_READ` and `MEMBERSHIP_MANAGE` behavior is enforced by the new provider using the approved shared security/user path. Do not create a second RBAC source or silently weaken endpoint permissions.

# LuckyHub 十业务服务代码拆分实施计划

**Goal:** 将当前 Marketing 中的业务域提取为五个独立服务模块，与现有 item/cart/user/trade/pay 组成十个业务服务，同时保持外部契约和当前线上单一写入者。

**Architecture:** 新建 `lottery-service`、`points-service`、`coupon-service`、`membership-service`、`fulfillment-service` 五个同级可部署模块；跨服务依赖经 `hm-api` 契约，不共享业务 Mapper/Entity。提取期间旧 Marketing 保持当前写入者，直到对应审计、数据回填、服务验收和路由切换条件全部通过。

**Tech Stack:** Java 17、Spring Boot 4.0.8、Maven reactor、MySQL/Flyway、Nacos、RabbitMQ、Redis/Redisson、Seata AT、hm-api、hm-security。

## 全局约束

- 现有服务保持 `item-service`、`cart-service`、`user-service`、`trade-service`、`pay-service`；共享 `hm-security` 不计作业务服务。
- Marketing V1–V28 不改写；新 schema 使用新增迁移，数据库不由本代码任务执行或初始化。
- 身份/RBAC 数据移动、Gateway/Nginx 路由切换、账号/业务数据修改等待只读审计与逐域切换验收；旧 Marketing 在此之前保持唯一写入者。
- 抽奖 Redis Lua、配额键、Redisson 锁、TTL 与对账行为原样保留。
- 保留用户 ID/业务号稳定性、API JSON/错误语义、事件幂等、Outbox、库存条件更新、不可变积分流水和冲正行为。
- 不新增、修改或删除交接文档；不清理或覆盖现有工作区改动；不启动 Compose、容器或应用服务。

## 执行顺序

1. **五个服务模块骨架**：根 reactor 注册五个模块；每个模块先有独立 Maven artifact、受限包扫描的 Spring Boot 启动类和服务名；不添加业务实现或写入端点。用静态合同测试验证模块清单、父 POM、启动类包名和不存在对 `marketing-service` 的依赖。

# 商品数据库渐进隔离设计

## 目标

在现有单 MySQL 8.4 实例内新增 `hm_item` 数据库，由 `item-service` 独占运行账号和数据写权限。迁移期间保留 `hmall.item`，避免订单、购物车仍在单体服务内直接访问商品表时中断。

## 本阶段边界

- 创建 `hm_item` 数据库和 `hm_item.item` 表。
- 首次及重复执行迁移时，以 `INSERT IGNORE` 从 `hmall.item` 补齐尚未迁移的商品。
- 创建 `hm_item_app` 运行账号，只授予 `hm_item.*` 的 `SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE`。
- `item-service` 使用 `hm_item_app` 连接 `hm_item`。
- `schema-init` 继续使用 root 执行建库、建表、建账号和授权。
- 不删除或修改 `hmall.item`，不建立跨库外键，不改订单和购物车业务代码。

## 后续迁移

订单和购物车改为调用 `item-service` 后，停止对 `hmall.item` 的写入并核对数据，再单独设计旧表下线。营销服务继续只保存 HMall 商品业务 ID，并通过接口获取商品信息。

## 验证

- 基础设施契约测试验证 SQL、Compose 挂载、密码传递和商品服务连接配置。

## 目标

- 删除 Spring Boot 打包插件，因为该模块不生成可执行服务。

## 代码边界

- `hm-api` 保留 `com.dongqh.hmapi.client.ItemClient` 和 `com.dongqh.hmapi.dto.ItemDTO`。
- `ItemClient` 返回 `hm-api` 自己的 `ItemDTO`，不能反向依赖 `cart-service`。
- 删除 `HmApiApplication`、`application.yaml` 和启动上下文测试。

`cart-service` 注入 `hm-api` 提供的 `ItemClient`，OpenFeign 根据服务名 `item-service` 向 Nacos 查询健康实例，经 Spring Cloud LoadBalancer 发送 `GET /items?ids=...`，并将响应反序列化为公共 `ItemDTO`。

- 本次不新增 Feign fallback 或熔断器，保持当前失败语义：商品服务不可用或返回错误时，购物车查询返回调用异常。

## 验证

- 执行 `mvn -pl :cart-service -am clean test`，验证 `hm-api`、`hm-common` 和 `cart-service` 在同一 Reactor 中成功构建。

仅完成用户、交易、支付三个领域的数据库物理隔离，以及对应 Spring 配置中的数据库连接信息。Java 业务代码、Maven 依赖、`hm-api` 和 OpenFeign 调用不在本次范围内。

## 拆分依据

以 `mysql/sqls` 中黑马商城提供的拆分 SQL 决定表的领域归属，以当前 `hmall` 数据库中的实际表结构和数据作为迁移源。这样既遵循教程的边界，也保留项目融合后新增的会员折扣、优惠券、订单金额和物流快照等字段。

## 目标数据库结构

### `hm_user`

- `user`
- `address`

账号为 `hm_user_app`，密码为 `hmall-lottery-user-dev`。

### `hm_trade`

- `order`
- `order_detail`
- `order_logistics`

账号为 `hm_trade_app`，密码为 `hmall-lottery-trade-dev`。

### `hm_pay`

- `pay_order`

账号为 `hm_pay_app`，密码为 `hmall-lottery-pay-dev`。

每个账号只获得所属数据库的 `SELECT`、`INSERT`、`UPDATE`、`DELETE` 权限，不授予其他业务库权限。

## 数据迁移

新增三个按顺序编号的、可重复执行的迁移 SQL：

1. 创建目标数据库和服务账号。
2. 使用 `CREATE TABLE ... LIKE hmall.<table>` 复制当前实际表结构。
3. 使用 `INSERT IGNORE ... SELECT ... FROM hmall.<table>` 复制现有数据，仅补充目标库缺失的主键记录。
4. 不删除或修改原 `hmall` 中的源表，保留其作为回滚与核对来源。

选择 `LIKE` 当前源表而不是直接执行官方数据文件，是因为官方 SQL 中含旧版字段、示例数据和 `DELETE` 语句，直接导入可能遗漏融合后的结构或覆盖现有数据。

迁移脚本接入根目录 `compose.yaml` 的 `schema-init` 服务，使已有 Docker 数据卷也能执行拆分，而不是只在首次创建 MySQL 容器时生效。

## YAML 配置

只调整数据库连接相关 YAML：

- `user-service` 指向 `hm_user`。
- `trade-service` 指向 `hm_trade`。
- `pay-service` 指向 `hm_pay`。
- `local` 配置连接 `127.0.0.1:13307`。
- `dev` 配置连接 Docker 网络中的 `mysql:3306`。
- 数据库用户名和密码按用户要求直接写在相应 YAML 中。

根 `compose.yaml` 的 `schema-init` 同步使用相同的三个账号密码，以创建或更新 MySQL 用户。除数据库连接配置外，不调整服务的其他配置。

## 验证标准

完成迁移后验证：

1. `hm_user`、`hm_trade`、`hm_pay` 均已创建。
2. 每个目标库的表集合与本设计一致。
3. 目标表字段与 `hmall` 对应源表一致。
4. 目标表数据行数与源表一致；重复执行迁移不会重复插入数据。
5. 三个服务账号能够连接并读写自己的数据库。
6. 三个服务账号不能访问另外两个新业务数据库。
7. 原 `hmall` 数据库和其中的源表仍然存在。
8. `docker compose config` 能正确解析更新后的 Compose 配置。

## 明确不做

- 不修改任何 Java 文件。
- 不调整 Maven 聚合或依赖。
- 不创建或修改 OpenFeign 客户端。
- 不移除单体数据库中的原表。
- 不处理跨服务事务或业务调用。

# LuckyHub 渐进式微服务拆分设计

## 1. 目标

在不丢失现有抽奖、营销资产和履约功能的前提下，将 `marketing-service` 中的 LuckyHub 单体拆分为：

- `lottery-service`：活动、奖池、抽奖、抽奖次数与抽奖可靠性；
- `marketing-service`：优惠券、积分、会员和商城营销结算；
- `fulfillment-service`：中奖权益、虚拟奖励发放和实物物流履约。

黑马商城已有的 `user-service`、`item-service`、`cart-service`、`trade-service` 和 `pay-service` 继续作为用户、商品、购物车、交易和支付的唯一事实来源。LuckyHub 不再维护重复的登录、用户、商品、现金订单、支付和收货地址主数据。

成功标准是：所有当前可用功能都有明确的新归属和回归验证；旧实现只能在替代链路通过验证并完成数据迁移后下线。

## 2. 已确定的技术基线

迁移期允许两套运行时并存：

- 黑马商城服务：Java 11、Spring Boot 2.7；
- LuckyHub 服务：Java 17、Spring Boot 4。

两套运行时统一使用以下工程与基础设施约定：

- Nacos 服务注册与发现；
- OpenFeign 服务间调用；
- MyBatis-Plus 数据访问；
- MySQL 独立数据库；
- Redis、Redisson 和 Redis Stream；
- Maven 聚合构建和统一模块命名；
- Nginx 作为浏览器统一入口；
- RS256 JWT 和 `Authorization` 请求头透传；
- Outbox、幂等消费、重试、隔离和对账补偿。

迁移期不让 LuckyHub 直接依赖 Spring Boot 2.7 的 `hm-common` 自动配置。新建 Java 17 的 `luckyhub-common`，仅供三个 LuckyHub 服务复用认证、异常、响应、请求 ID 和基础配置。未来全体升级 Java 17 / Spring Boot 4 后，再将 `hm-common` 与 `luckyhub-common` 合并。

`hm-api` 保持 Java 11 可消费的纯契约 JAR，只包含 DTO、OpenFeign Client 和 Feign 配置，不包含 Controller、数据库、Swagger UI 或业务实现。契约不得暴露 `javax.servlet`、`jakarta.servlet`、MyBatis Entity 或某个服务的内部异常类型，从而允许两套运行时共同使用。

## 3. 迁移策略比较

### 方案 A：一次性拆分并切换

一次性建立三个服务、拆库、替换所有调用并删除旧代码。最终结构形成较快，但任一链路失败都会阻断整体上线，难以判断功能是拆分前就异常还是迁移引入异常。

### 方案 B：先拆包，再一次性拆库

先在当前单体内部整理依赖，完成后一次性建立三个服务和数据库。代码风险低于方案 A，但数据库和运行流量仍存在一次性切换风险。

### 方案 C：模块化单体加渐进式绞杀迁移

先建立契约和边界测试，让旧接口继续提供服务；逐个接入黑马主数据和新服务；按功能迁移数据与流量；验证通过后删除旧轨。该方案步骤较多，但每一步都可回滚，最符合“功能不缺失”的要求。

本设计采用方案 C。

## 4. 最终服务边界

### 4.1 user-service

唯一负责：

- 用户账号、密码和状态；
- RS256 JWT 签发；
- `USER`、`ADMIN` 角色；
- 用户收货地址主数据。

LuckyHub 只保存外部 `userId` 和业务发生时的必要快照，不创建用户投影、不自动创建营销用户，也不保存商城密码。

### 4.2 item-service

唯一负责：

- 商品主数据；
- 商品上下架状态；
- 商城真实库存；
- 商品详情查询和库存扣减。

营销侧可以维护“活动奖池额度”或“兑换活动额度”，但字段和接口必须明确命名为 `quota`，不得伪装成第二套商品库存。如果营销商品与商城共享实物库存，必须通过 `ItemClient` 预占、确认或释放。

### 4.3 trade-service 与 pay-service

`trade-service` 唯一负责现金商城订单、订单明细和商城订单物流状态；`pay-service` 唯一负责支付单和支付状态。

交易创建时调用营销服务查询会员折扣并预占优惠券；支付成功后写入 Outbox，向营销服务发布 `OrderPaidEventV1`。LuckyHub 不再提供 `/api/orders`、`/api/payments` 或支付模拟接口。

### 4.4 lottery-service

负责：

- 活动创建、发布、禁用和状态刷新；
- 奖品、奖池、权重和活动奖池额度；
- 单抽、十连抽、抽奖请求幂等；
- 抽奖资格和每日配额；
- 抽奖次数账户、预留、确认、释放和流水；
- Redisson 用户/活动锁；
- Redis Lua 配额预留、确认和释放；
- MySQL 条件扣减活动奖池额度；
- 抽奖订单、抽奖记录和奖励快照；
- 抽奖 Outbox、Redis Stream 发布和对账补偿。

抽奖事务成功后发布 `LotteryRewardCreatedEventV1`，不直接写优惠券、积分、会员、权益或物流数据库。

### 4.5 marketing-service

负责：

- 优惠券模板、发放、查询、锁定、核销、释放和过期；
- 商品、分类、品牌优惠券范围；
- 积分账户、不可变流水、调整、反向流水和积分兑换；
- 基于黑马 `itemId` 的积分兑换活动；
- 会员产品、用户会员和会员发放记录；
- 会员折扣查询；
- 消费 `OrderPaidEventV1` 发放积分及营销奖励。

积分兑换活动拥有的是营销额度 `availableQuota`。真实商品库存仍由 `item-service` 决定。

### 4.6 fulfillment-service

负责：

- 用户中奖权益记录；
- 奖励发放任务、尝试记录、重试和隔离；
- 消费 `LotteryRewardCreatedEventV1`；
- 调用 `marketing-service` 发放优惠券、积分和会员；
- 调用 `lottery-service` 发放抽奖次数；
- 实物权益领取期限；
- 从 `user-service` 读取地址并保存不可变加密快照；
- 奖品发货单、物流轨迹、回调验签、脱敏查询和异常处理。

模拟优惠券、积分、会员和物流 Gateway 只允许在 `dev`、`test` Profile 注册。生产 Profile 必须使用真实 Feign Gateway，缺少真实实现时应启动失败，不能静默使用模拟器。

## 7. 服务调用与事件

同步调用使用 OpenFeign：

- `trade-service -> marketing-service`：会员折扣、优惠券试算、预占、确认、释放；
- `lottery-service -> item-service`：商品奖励定义校验和商品快照；
- `marketing-service -> item-service`：积分兑换商品校验与库存操作；
- `fulfillment-service -> user-service`：读取本人地址；
- `fulfillment-service -> item-service`：实物商品校验；
- `fulfillment-service -> marketing-service`：幂等发放优惠券、积分和会员；
- `fulfillment-service -> lottery-service`：幂等发放抽奖次数。

异步调用沿用 Outbox 和 Redis Stream：

- `OrderPaidEventV1`：商城支付完成，营销服务发放订单积分或抽奖次数；
- `LotteryRewardCreatedEventV1`：抽奖奖励已冻结，履约服务创建权益和发放任务；
- `PointsRedemptionCreatedEventV1`：实物积分兑换已扣除营销额度和积分，履约服务创建地址快照与发货单；
- `FulfillmentStatusChangedEventV1`：可选，用于抽奖结果和权益页面投影状态。

事件必须包含：`eventId`、`eventType`、`eventVersion`、`occurredAt`、`traceId`、`businessNo`、`userId` 和负载。消费者以 `eventId + consumerName` 建唯一键，业务写入以 `businessNo` 建唯一键。

`LotteryRewardCreatedEventV1` 必须携带不可变奖励快照和稳定的 `benefitNo`。抽奖接口仍立即返回中奖结果；权益发放状态允许短暂显示为 `PENDING`，但已有数字 `benefitId` 接口在迁移期继续保留。履约服务完成权益投影后，旧 ID 与新 `benefitNo` 的映射必须可查询，确保 `/benefits/{id}/claim` 等现有页面和接口不失效。

## 8. 认证、授权和接口兼容

`user-service` 是唯一 Token 签发方。Nginx 原样转发 `Authorization`；各服务只验证 RS256 签名、过期时间、`user` 和 `role`。

迁移期保留现有浏览器路径：

- `/api/marketing/lottery/**` 路由到 `lottery-service`；
- `/api/marketing/coupons/**`、`points/**`、`memberships/**` 路由到 `marketing-service`；
- `/api/marketing/benefits/**`、`shipping/**` 路由到 `fulfillment-service`。

外部响应结构和字段在切流期间保持兼容。服务间接口使用明确的内部路径和 DTO，不使用浏览器响应包装类作为 Feign 契约。

管理员权限迁移期仍按黑马 `ADMIN` 角色映射全部后台权限，普通用户只获得本人数据权限。所有用户数据查询必须同时带可信 `userId` 条件，不能只依赖前端参数。

## 9. 可靠性和失败处理

- 抽奖配额：Redis Lua 原子预留，MySQL 为最终事实，对账任务回收超时预留；
- 活动奖池额度：SQL 条件更新，禁止先查后扣；
- 事件：本地事务写 Outbox，Relay 租约领取，成功确认，失败指数退避；
- 奖励履约：至少一次投递加业务幂等，结果未知时查询下游状态，不能直接重发；
- 优惠券：预占、使用、释放均为 CAS 状态迁移；
- 积分：账户余额加不可变流水，冲正产生反向流水，不更新原流水；
- 实物地址：请求时从 `user-service` 读取本人地址，保存加密不可变快照；
- 物流回调：验签、时间窗、回调幂等和合法状态机；
- 跨服务调用：设置连接、读取超时；只有幂等读或带业务号的写允许重试；
- 生产环境不允许自动回退到本地模拟 Gateway。

## 10. 实施阶段和回滚门禁

### 阶段 1：黑马微服务运行基线

让 Compose 启动 item、cart、user、trade、pay，Nacos 注册正常；清理 `hm-api`；旧 `mall-service` 暂时作为回滚路径。通过商城登录、商品、购物车、下单和支付回归后，浏览器流量切向五服务。

### 阶段 2：统一身份和商城主数据

LuckyHub 全部使用黑马 JWT、用户 ID、商品和地址接口。先停止调用旧登录、用户投影、本地商品和本地地址接口，再删除对应代码和表。

### 阶段 3：删除迷你商城旧轨

积分兑换切到 `offerId + hmallItemId`；现金订单切到 `trade-service`；支付切到 `pay-service`；活动奖池额度与商品库存分离。每条新链路通过后删除 `catalog`、`order`、`payment` 和 `inventory/channel`。

### 阶段 4：抽取 lottery-service

先移动代码并保持旧数据库访问，再建立 `hm_lottery` baseline 和数据迁移，最后切换 Nginx 路由。验证抽奖并发、幂等、配额、Outbox、Stream 和对账后停止旧抽奖 Bean。

### 阶段 5：抽取 fulfillment-service

建立事件契约和消费幂等，迁移权益、履约与物流表，启用真实 Feign Gateway。验证五类奖励、领取期限、地址快照、物流回调、失败重试和隔离后切换路由。

### 阶段 6：营销库独立与最终清理

将剩余优惠券、积分和会员数据迁入 `hm_marketing`，删除 LuckyHub 本地认证/RBAC CRUD、模拟生产 Bean、旧 Controller、旧表访问和兼容构造器。原 `luckyhub` 数据库保留只读观察期后再人工归档。

每个阶段必须满足以下门禁才能进入下一阶段：

1. 新增契约测试先失败，再由实现使其通过；
2. 对应服务单元与集成测试通过；
3. 全量工作区契约测试通过；
4. 全新数据库从零迁移通过；
5. 核心页面和 API 冒烟通过；
6. 数据迁移核对通过；
7. 已记录明确的回滚路由和数据处理方式。

## 11. 功能不缺失验收矩阵

- 用户和管理员使用黑马账号登录并访问各自接口；

- Outbox Relay、Redis Stream Pending 重领、重复事件消费和超时对账；
