server:
  port: 8080
spring:
  main:
    web-application-type: reactive
  application:
    name: gateway
  cloud:
    nacos:
      server-addr: ${NACOS_SERVER_ADDR:127.0.0.1:18848}
      username: ${NACOS_USERNAME:nacos}
      password: ${NACOS_PASSWORD:nacos}
      discovery:
        enabled: true
        register-enabled: true
        group: DEFAULT_GROUP
    gateway:
      server:
        webflux:
          routes:
            - id: item-service
              uri: lb://item-service
              predicates:
                - Path=/items/**,/search/**
              filters:
                - AddRequestHeader=truth, anyone will be rich
            - id: cart-service
              uri: lb://cart-service
              predicates:
                - Path=/carts/**
            - id: user-service
              uri: lb://user-service
              predicates:
                - Path=/addresses/**,/users/**
            - id: trade-service
              uri: lb://trade-service
              predicates:
                - Path=/orders/**
            - id: pay-service
              uri: lb://pay-service
              predicates:
                - Path=/pay-orders/**
            - id: points-service
              uri: ${POINTS_SERVICE_URI:lb://points-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/points/**,/api/admin/points/**
            - id: coupon-service
              uri: ${COUPON_SERVICE_URI:lb://coupon-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/coupons/**,/api/admin/coupon-templates/**,/api/admin/coupons/**
            - id: membership-service
              uri: ${MEMBERSHIP_SERVICE_URI:lb://membership-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/memberships/**,/api/admin/membership-products/**
            - id: lottery-service
              uri: ${LOTTERY_SERVICE_URI:lb://lottery-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/lottery/**,/api/benefits/**,/api/admin/activities/**,/api/admin/prizes/**,/api/admin/prize-images/**,/api/admin/reward-definitions/**
            - id: fulfillment-service
              uri: ${FULFILLMENT_SERVICE_URI:lb://fulfillment-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/shipping/**,/api/admin/shipping/**,/api/admin/fulfillment/**
hm:
  jwt:
    public-key-location: classpath:hmall-public.pem
  auth:
    excludePaths:
      - GET /search/**
      - POST /search/filters
      - POST /users/login
      - GET /items/**
      - GET /hi
      - POST /api/shipping/callbacks/logistics

au BufRead,BufNewFile *.nginx set ft=nginx
au BufRead,BufNewFile */etc/nginx/* set ft=nginx
au BufRead,BufNewFile */usr/local/nginx/conf/* set ft=nginx
au BufRead,BufNewFile nginx.conf set ft=nginx
setlocal commentstring=#\ %s

if exists("b:did_indent")
    finish
endif
let b:did_indent = 1

setlocal indentexpr=

" cindent actually works for nginx' simple file structure
setlocal cindent
" Just make sure that the comments are not reset as defs would be.
setlocal cinkeys-=0#

" Vim syntax file
" Language: nginx.conf

if exists("b:current_syntax")
  finish
end

" general syntax

if has("patch-7.4.1142")
    " except control characters, ";", "{", and "}"
    syn iskeyword 33-58,60-122,124,126-255
endif

syn match ngxName '\([^;{} \t\\]\|\\.\)\+'
    \ contains=@ngxDirectives
    \ nextgroup=@ngxParams skipwhite skipempty
syn match ngxParam '\(\${\|[^;{ \t\\]\|\\.\)\+'
    \ contained
    \ contains=ngxVariable
    \ nextgroup=@ngxParams skipwhite skipempty
syn region ngxString start=+\z(["']\)+ end=+\z1+ skip=+\\\\\|\\\z1+
    \ contains=ngxVariableString
    \ nextgroup=@ngxParams skipwhite skipempty
syn match ngxParamComment '#.*$'
    \ nextgroup=@ngxParams skipwhite skipempty
syn match ngxSemicolon ';' contained
syn region ngxBlock start=+{+ end=+}+ contained
    \ contains=@ngxTopLevel
syn match ngxComment '#.*$'

syn match ngxVariable '\$\(\w\+\|{\w\+}\)' contained
syn match ngxVariableString '\$\(\w\+\|{\w\+}\)' contained

syn cluster ngxTopLevel
    \ contains=ngxName,ngxString,ngxComment
syn cluster ngxDirectives
    \ contains=ngxDirective,ngxDirectiveBlock,ngxDirectiveImportant
    \ add=ngxDirectiveControl,ngxDirectiveError,ngxDirectiveDeprecated
    \ add=ngxDirectiveThirdParty,ngxDirectiveThirdPartyDeprecated
syn cluster ngxParams
    \ contains=ngxParam,ngxString,ngxParamComment,ngxSemicolon,ngxBlock

" boolean parameters

syn keyword ngxBoolean contained on off
    \ nextgroup=@ngxParams skipwhite skipempty
syn cluster ngxParams add=ngxBoolean

" listen directive

syn cluster ngxTopLevel add=ngxDirectiveListen
syn keyword ngxDirectiveListen listen
    \ nextgroup=@ngxListenParams skipwhite skipempty
syn match ngxListenParam '\(\${\|[^;{ \t\\]\|\\.\)\+'
    \ contained
    \ nextgroup=@ngxListenParams skipwhite skipempty
syn region ngxListenString start=+\z(["']\)+ end=+\z1+ skip=+\\\\\|\\\z1+
    \ contained
    \ nextgroup=@ngxListenParams skipwhite skipempty
syn match ngxListenComment '#.*$'
    \ contained
    \ nextgroup=@ngxListenParams skipwhite skipempty
syn keyword ngxListenOptions contained
    \ default_server ssl http2 proxy_protocol
    \ setfib fastopen backlog rcvbuf sndbuf accept_filter deferred bind
    \ ipv6only reuseport so_keepalive
    \ nextgroup=@ngxListenParams skipwhite skipempty
syn keyword ngxListenOptionsDeprecated contained
    \ spdy
    \ nextgroup=@ngxListenParams skipwhite skipempty
syn cluster ngxListenParams
    \ contains=ngxListenParam,ngxListenString,ngxListenComment
    \ add=ngxListenOptions,ngxListenOptionsDeprecated

ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
WORKDIR /app

EXPOSE 8081
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "/app/app.jar"]

spring:
  config:
    # IDEA 默认不会加载根目录 .env；同时兼容以仓库根目录或模块目录作为工作目录。
    import:
      - "optional:file:.env[.properties]"
      - "optional:file:../.env[.properties]"

hm:
  db:
    # IDEA 本地启动时，通过宿主机映射端口连接 Docker 中的 MySQL。
    port: ${HM_ITEM_DB_PORT:13307}
    host: 127.0.0.1
    database: hm_item
    username: hm_item_app
    password: ${HM_ITEM_DB_PASSWORD:change-item-db-password}

server:
  port: 8081
spring:
  application:
    name: item-service
  profiles:
    active: ${SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE:local}
  config:
    import:
      - "optional:nacos:shared.jdbc.yaml?group=DEFAULT_GROUP&refreshEnabled=true"
      - "optional:nacos:shared.logger.yaml?group=DEFAULT_GROUP&refreshEnabled=true"
      - "optional:nacos:shared.swagger.yaml?group=DEFAULT_GROUP&refreshEnabled=true"
      - "optional:nacos:${spring.application.name}.yaml?group=DEFAULT_GROUP&refreshEnabled=true"
  cloud:
    nacos:
      server-addr: ${NACOS_SERVER_ADDR:127.0.0.1:18848}
      username: ${NACOS_USERNAME:nacos}
      password: ${NACOS_PASSWORD:nacos}
      config:
        group: DEFAULT_GROUP
      discovery:
        enabled: true
        register-enabled: true
        group: DEFAULT_GROUP
hm:
  swagger:
    title: 黑马商城商品管理接口文档
    description: 黑马商城商品管理接口文档
    package: com.dongqh.itemservice.controller
seata:
  enabled: ${SEATA_ENABLED:true}
  application-id: ${spring.application.name}
  tx-service-group: hmall_tx_group
  enable-auto-data-source-proxy: true
  data-source-proxy-mode: AT
  service:
    vgroup-mapping:
      hmall_tx_group: default
  registry:
    type: nacos
    nacos:
      application: seata-server
      server-addr: ${NACOS_SERVER_ADDR:127.0.0.1:18848}
      group: DEFAULT_GROUP
      namespace: ""
      cluster: default
      username: ${NACOS_USERNAME:nacos}
      password: ${NACOS_PASSWORD:nacos}

spring:
  flyway:
    enabled: ${ITEM_FLYWAY_ENABLED:false}
    locations: classpath:db/migration
    baseline-on-migrate: true
    baseline-version: 0

CREATE TABLE product (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    product_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    product_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    product_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    image_url VARCHAR(500) NULL,
    description VARCHAR(1000) NULL,
    status TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_product_code (product_code),
    KEY idx_product_status_created (status, created_at),
    CONSTRAINT chk_product_type CHECK (product_type IN ('PHYSICAL', 'VIRTUAL')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_product_status CHECK (status IN (0, 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Marketing商品目录';

CREATE TABLE product_sku (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    product_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    sku_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    sku_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    cash_price_cent BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    points_price BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    cash_enabled TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    points_enabled TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    version INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_product_sku_code (sku_code),
    KEY idx_product_sku_product (product_id, status),
    CONSTRAINT chk_product_sku_cash CHECK (
        (cash_enabled = 0) OR (cash_enabled = 1 AND cash_price_cent IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_product_sku_points CHECK (
        (points_enabled = 0) OR (points_enabled = 1 AND points_price IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_product_sku_enabled CHECK (cash_enabled IN (0, 1) AND points_enabled IN (0, 1)),
    CONSTRAINT chk_product_sku_status CHECK (status IN (0, 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Marketing商品SKU';

CREATE TABLE sku_inventory (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    sku_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    total_stock INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    allocated_stock INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    version INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_sku_inventory_sku (sku_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_sku_inventory_allocation CHECK (allocated_stock <= total_stock)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Marketing SKU总库存';

CREATE TABLE inventory_channel_stock (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    sku_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    channel_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    allocated_stock INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    available_stock INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    reserved_stock INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    consumed_stock INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    version INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_channel_stock_sku_channel (sku_id, channel_code),
    KEY idx_channel_stock_channel (channel_code),
    CONSTRAINT chk_channel_stock_balance CHECK (
        allocated_stock = available_stock + reserved_stock + consumed_stock
    )
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Marketing SKU渠道库存';

CREATE TABLE inventory_reservation (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    reservation_no VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    sku_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    channel_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    quantity INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_inventory_reservation_no (reservation_no),
    KEY idx_inventory_reservation_sku_channel (sku_id, channel_code),
    CONSTRAINT chk_inventory_reservation_quantity CHECK (quantity > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_inventory_reservation_status CHECK (
        status IN ('RESERVED', 'CONFIRMED', 'RELEASED', 'REVERSED')
    )
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Marketing SKU渠道库存预占';

CREATE TABLE inventory_ledger (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    business_no VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    sku_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    hmall_item_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    channel_code VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    operation VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    quantity INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_inventory_ledger_business_no (business_no),
    KEY idx_inventory_ledger_sku_created (sku_id, created_at),
    KEY idx_inventory_ledger_hmall_item_created (hmall_item_id, created_at),
    CONSTRAINT chk_inventory_ledger_identity CHECK (
        (sku_id IS NOT NULL AND hmall_item_id IS NULL)
        OR (sku_id IS NULL AND hmall_item_id IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_inventory_ledger_quantity CHECK (quantity > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_inventory_ledger_operation CHECK (
        operation IN ('INITIALIZE', 'ALLOCATE', 'RESERVE', 'CONFIRM', 'RELEASE', 'RETURN', 'CLAIM_RETURN')
    )
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='库存不可变流水';

FROM maven:3.9.9-eclipse-temurin-17 AS build
WORKDIR /workspace
COPY . .
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.m2 \
    mvn -B -ntp -pl lottery-service -am package -Dmaven.test.skip=true

WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /workspace/lottery-service/target/*.jar /app/app.jar
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["java", "-jar", "/app/app.jar"]

CREATE TABLE reward_definition (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    reward_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    reward_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    reward_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    target_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    quantity BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    config_snapshot JSON NULL,
    status TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_reward_definition_code (reward_code),
    KEY idx_reward_definition_type_status (reward_type, status),
    CONSTRAINT chk_reward_definition_type CHECK (
        reward_type IN ('PRODUCT', 'COUPON', 'POINTS', 'MEMBERSHIP', 'DRAW_CHANCE')
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_reward_definition_quantity CHECK (quantity > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_reward_definition_status CHECK (status IN (0, 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='统一奖励定义';

CREATE TABLE marketing_prize (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    prize_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '奖品名称',
    prize_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL COMMENT '奖品类型',
    reward_definition_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    prize_level VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL COMMENT '奖品等级',
    image_url VARCHAR(500) NULL COMMENT '图片地址',
    description VARCHAR(500) NULL COMMENT '奖品说明',
    stackable TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '是否可叠加：0-否，1-是',
    status TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '状态：0-禁用，1-启用',
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '修改时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    KEY idx_marketing_prize_type (prize_type),
    KEY idx_marketing_prize_status (status),
    KEY idx_marketing_prize_reward_definition (reward_definition_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_marketing_prize_stackable CHECK (stackable IN (0, 1)),
    CONSTRAINT chk_marketing_prize_status CHECK (status IN (0, 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='奖品表';

CREATE TABLE marketing_activity (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    activity_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '活动名称',
    description VARCHAR(1000) NULL COMMENT '活动说明',
    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' COMMENT '活动状态',
    start_time DATETIME(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '开始时间',
    end_time DATETIME(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '结束时间',
    daily_limit INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '用户每日参与次数上限',
    no_win_weight INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '独立未中奖权重',
    created_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '创建人ID',
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '修改时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    KEY idx_marketing_activity_status (status),
    KEY idx_marketing_activity_start_time (start_time),
    KEY idx_marketing_activity_end_time (end_time),
    KEY idx_marketing_activity_name (activity_name),
    KEY idx_marketing_activity_created_by (created_by),
    CONSTRAINT chk_marketing_activity_time CHECK (end_time > start_time),
    CONSTRAINT chk_marketing_activity_daily_limit CHECK (daily_limit > 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='营销活动表';

CREATE TABLE marketing_activity_prize (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    activity_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '活动ID',
    prize_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '奖品ID',
    weight INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '中奖权重',
    total_stock INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '总库存',
    remaining_stock INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '数据库剩余库存',
    sort_order INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '展示顺序',
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '修改时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_activity_prize (activity_id, prize_id),
    KEY idx_activity_prize_prize_id (prize_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_activity_prize_weight CHECK (weight > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_activity_prize_stock CHECK (remaining_stock <= total_stock)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='活动奖品表';

CREATE TABLE lottery_draw_order (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    request_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '请求唯一标识',
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '用户ID',
    activity_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '活动ID',
    draw_count INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '抽奖次数',
    draw_date DATE NOT NULL COMMENT '上海时区抽奖日期',
    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PROCESSING' COMMENT '订单状态',
    fail_reason VARCHAR(500) NULL COMMENT '失败原因',
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
    completed_at DATETIME(3) NULL COMMENT '完成时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_lottery_draw_order_request_id (request_id),
    KEY idx_draw_order_user_id (user_id),
    KEY idx_draw_order_activity_id (activity_id),
    KEY idx_draw_order_status (status),
    KEY idx_draw_order_created_at (created_at),
    CONSTRAINT chk_draw_order_count CHECK (draw_count IN (1, 10)),
    CONSTRAINT chk_draw_order_status CHECK (status IN ('PROCESSING', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='抽奖订单表';

CREATE TABLE lottery_draw_record (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    order_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '抽奖订单ID',
    request_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '请求ID',
    sequence_no INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '结果序号',
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '用户ID',
    activity_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '活动ID',
    result_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'WIN',
    prize_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL COMMENT '奖品ID',
    prize_name VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    prize_type VARCHAR(30) NULL,
    prize_image_url VARCHAR(1000) NULL,
    reward_definition_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    reward_type VARCHAR(30) NULL,
    reward_target_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    reward_quantity BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    reward_payload JSON NULL,
    reward_fingerprint CHAR(64) NULL,
    draw_time DATETIME(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '抽奖时间',
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_draw_record_request_sequence (request_id, sequence_no),
    KEY idx_draw_record_order_id (order_id),
    KEY idx_draw_record_user_id (user_id),
    KEY idx_draw_record_activity_id (activity_id),
    KEY idx_draw_record_prize_id (prize_id),
    KEY idx_draw_record_draw_time (draw_time),
    KEY idx_draw_record_reward_definition (reward_definition_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_draw_record_sequence CHECK (sequence_no > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_draw_record_reward_type CHECK (
        reward_type IS NULL OR reward_type IN ('PRODUCT','COUPON','POINTS','MEMBERSHIP','DRAW_CHANCE')
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_draw_record_reward_quantity CHECK (reward_quantity IS NULL OR reward_quantity > 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='中奖记录表';

CREATE TABLE user_benefit (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    draw_record_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '用户ID',
    prize_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '奖品ID',
    prize_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    reward_definition_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    reward_type VARCHAR(30) NULL,
    reward_target_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    reward_quantity BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    reward_payload JSON NULL,
    reward_fingerprint CHAR(64) NULL,
    fulfillment_no VARCHAR(64) NULL,
    quantity INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '数量',
    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AVAILABLE' COMMENT '权益状态',
    grant_error VARCHAR(500) NULL,
    obtained_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '获得时间',
    expire_at DATETIME(3) NULL COMMENT '过期时间',
    claim_deadline DATETIME(3) NULL,
    claimed_at DATETIME(3) NULL,
    shipping_order_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '修改时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_user_benefit_draw_record (draw_record_id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_user_benefit_fulfillment (fulfillment_no),
    KEY idx_user_benefit_user_id (user_id),
    KEY idx_user_benefit_prize_id (prize_id),
    KEY idx_user_benefit_status (status),
    KEY idx_user_benefit_obtained_at (obtained_at),
    KEY idx_user_benefit_reward_definition (reward_definition_id),
    KEY idx_user_benefit_claim_expiry (status, claim_deadline, id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_user_benefit_quantity CHECK (quantity > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_user_benefit_expire_time CHECK (expire_at IS NULL OR expire_at > obtained_at),
    CONSTRAINT chk_user_benefit_reward_type CHECK (
        reward_type IS NULL OR reward_type IN ('PRODUCT','COUPON','POINTS','MEMBERSHIP','DRAW_CHANCE')
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_user_benefit_reward_quantity CHECK (reward_quantity IS NULL OR reward_quantity > 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='用户权益表';

CREATE TABLE message_outbox (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    event_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '事件唯一标识',
    event_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '事件类型',
    event_version INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '事件版本',
    aggregate_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '聚合类型',
    aggregate_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '聚合标识',
    payload JSON NOT NULL COMMENT '事件载荷',
    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' COMMENT '投递状态',
    retry_count INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '重试次数',
    last_error VARCHAR(500) NULL COMMENT '最近一次投递失败的安全错误',
    claim_token VARCHAR(64) NULL COMMENT '当前投递租约令牌',
    next_retry_at DATETIME(3) NULL COMMENT '下次重试或租约到期时间',
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
    sent_at DATETIME(3) NULL COMMENT '发送时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_message_outbox_event_id (event_id),
    KEY idx_message_outbox_status_retry (status, next_retry_at),
    CONSTRAINT chk_message_outbox_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'SENT', 'FAILED'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='可靠事件发件箱';

CREATE TABLE message_consume_record (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    event_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '事件唯一标识',
    consumer_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '消费者名称',
    consumed_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '消费时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_message_consume_event_consumer (event_id, consumer_name)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='消息消费幂等记录';

CREATE TABLE draw_chance_account (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    available_balance BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reserved_balance BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    version INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_draw_chance_account_user (user_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_draw_chance_account_balances CHECK (available_balance >= 0 AND reserved_balance >= 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='奖励抽奖次数账户';

CREATE TABLE draw_chance_ledger (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    business_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    business_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    direction VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    amount BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    available_after BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    reserved_after BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_draw_chance_ledger_business (business_type, business_id),
    KEY idx_draw_chance_ledger_user_created (user_id, created_at, id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_draw_chance_ledger_business_type CHECK (
        business_type IN ('LOTTERY_REWARD','DRAW_CONSUME','DRAW_RELEASE','MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT')
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_draw_chance_ledger_direction CHECK (direction IN ('CREDIT','DEBIT')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_draw_chance_ledger_amount CHECK (amount > 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='奖励抽奖次数不可变流水';

CREATE TABLE draw_chance_reservation (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    request_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    activity_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    draw_date DATE NOT NULL,
    draw_count INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    bonus_reserved BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,

    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),

    UNIQUE KEY uk_draw_chance_reservation_request (request_id),
    KEY idx_draw_chance_reservation_user_date (user_id, draw_date, status, id),
    KEY idx_draw_chance_reservation_reconcile (status, created_at, id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_draw_chance_reservation_count CHECK (draw_count IN (1,10)),
    CONSTRAINT chk_draw_chance_reservation_status CHECK (status IN ('RESERVED','CONFIRMED','RELEASED'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='奖励抽奖次数预留';

CREATE TABLE lottery_reward_quarantine (

    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: ${MYSQL_DATABASE}
      MYSQL_USER: ${MYSQL_USER}
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_PASSWORD}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      TZ: Asia/Shanghai
    ports:
      - "${MYSQL_PORT:-3306}:3306"
    volumes:
      - luckyhub-mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -uroot -p$$MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD --silent"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20
      start_period: 20s

  redis:
    image: redis:7.4-alpine
    container_name: luckyhub-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      REDIS_PASSWORD: ${REDIS_PASSWORD}
    command: ["redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes", "--requirepass", "${REDIS_PASSWORD}"]
    ports:
      - "${REDIS_PORT:-6379}:6379"
    volumes:
      - luckyhub-redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "redis-cli -a $$REDIS_PASSWORD --no-auth-warning ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

volumes:
  luckyhub-mysql-data:
  luckyhub-redis-data:

# LuckyHub

LuckyHub 是基于 Java 17、Spring Boot、MyBatis-Plus、MySQL 和 Redis 的抽奖营销服务。

## 本地启动

1. 将 `.env.example` 复制为 `.env`，填写数据库、Redis、JWT 和 OSS 配置。
2. 启动依赖：

```powershell
docker compose up -d
```

3. 运行测试：

```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Invoke-Maven.ps1 test
```

4. 启动应用：

```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Invoke-Maven.ps1 spring-boot:run
```

Swagger UI 地址为 `http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html`。

[`docs/prize-management-api.md`](docs/prize-management-api.md)。

-- 危险操作：本脚本会删除以下三个角色及其全部用户、权限关联。
-- 仅在确认 RBAC_VIEWER、USER_OPERATOR、RBAC_OPERATOR 属于本地测试数据时手工执行。
-- 不删除用户，也不删除 Flyway V2 初始化的基础权限。

START TRANSACTION;

DELETE user_role
FROM sys_user_role AS user_role
JOIN sys_role AS test_role
    ON test_role.id = user_role.role_id
WHERE test_role.role_code IN ('RBAC_VIEWER', 'USER_OPERATOR', 'RBAC_OPERATOR');

DELETE role_permission
FROM sys_role_permission AS role_permission
JOIN sys_role AS test_role
    ON test_role.id = role_permission.role_id
WHERE test_role.role_code IN ('RBAC_VIEWER', 'USER_OPERATOR', 'RBAC_OPERATOR');

DELETE FROM sys_role
WHERE role_code IN ('RBAC_VIEWER', 'USER_OPERATOR', 'RBAC_OPERATOR');

COMMIT;

-- LuckyHub RBAC 与 Redis 权限缓存手工验证数据。
-- 本脚本可重复执行：只补充缺失角色及关联，不覆盖或删除已有数据。

START TRANSACTION;

INSERT INTO sys_role (role_code, role_name, status)
SELECT seed.role_code, seed.role_name, 1
FROM (
    SELECT 'RBAC_VIEWER' AS role_code, 'RBAC只读员' AS role_name
    UNION ALL SELECT 'USER_OPERATOR', '用户运营员'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'RBAC_OPERATOR', 'RBAC操作员'
) AS seed
LEFT JOIN sys_role AS existing_role
    ON existing_role.role_code = seed.role_code
WHERE existing_role.id IS NULL;

INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id)
SELECT target_role.id, target_permission.id
FROM (
    SELECT 'RBAC_VIEWER' AS role_code, 'user:read' AS permission_code
    UNION ALL SELECT 'RBAC_VIEWER', 'role:read'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'RBAC_VIEWER', 'permission:read'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'RBAC_VIEWER', 'user-role:read'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'RBAC_VIEWER', 'role-permission:read'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'RBAC_VIEWER', 'user-permission:read'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'USER_OPERATOR', 'user:create'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'USER_OPERATOR', 'user:read'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'USER_OPERATOR', 'user-role:assign'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'USER_OPERATOR', 'user-role:read'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'USER_OPERATOR', 'user-permission:read'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'RBAC_OPERATOR', 'role:create'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'RBAC_OPERATOR', 'role:read'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'RBAC_OPERATOR', 'permission:create'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'RBAC_OPERATOR', 'permission:read'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'RBAC_OPERATOR', 'role-permission:assign'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'RBAC_OPERATOR', 'role-permission:read'
) AS seed
JOIN sys_role AS target_role
    ON target_role.role_code = seed.role_code
JOIN sys_permission AS target_permission
    ON target_permission.permission_code = seed.permission_code
LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission AS existing_relation
    ON existing_relation.role_id = target_role.id
    AND existing_relation.permission_id = target_permission.id
WHERE existing_relation.role_id IS NULL;

INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id)
SELECT target_user.id, target_role.id
FROM (
    SELECT 'player01' AS username, 'RBAC_VIEWER' AS role_code
    UNION ALL SELECT 'admin', 'RBAC_VIEWER'
) AS seed
JOIN sys_user AS target_user
    ON target_user.username = seed.username
JOIN sys_role AS target_role
    ON target_role.role_code = seed.role_code
LEFT JOIN sys_user_role AS existing_relation
    ON existing_relation.user_id = target_user.id
    AND existing_relation.role_id = target_role.id
WHERE existing_relation.user_id IS NULL;

COMMIT;

@Service public class OrderPricingServiceImpl implements OrderPricingService { public OrderPriceQuote quote(PurchasableSkuSnapshot sku,int quantity,ActiveMembershipBenefit m,CouponLockSnapshot c){try{long original=Math.multiplyExact(sku.cashPriceCent(),quantity);long after=m==null?original:Math.multiplyExact(original,m.discountBasisPoints())/10000;long memberDiscount=original-after;long couponDiscount=c==null?0:Math.min(c.discountCent(),after);long payable=Math.subtractExact(after,couponDiscount);return new OrderPriceQuote(original,m==null?null:m.membershipLevel(),m==null?null:m.discountBasisPoints(),memberDiscount,after,c==null?null:c.userCouponId(),c==null?null:c.templateId(),c==null?null:c.couponName(),couponDiscount,payable);}catch(ArithmeticException e){throw new BusinessException(OrderErrorCode.PRICE_OVERFLOW);}} }

spring:
  application:
    name: marketing-service
  config:
    import:
      - optional:file:.env[.properties]
      - optional:file:../.env[.properties]
  datasource:
    driver-class-name: com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
    url: jdbc:mysql://${MYSQL_HOST:localhost}:${MYSQL_PORT:3306}/${MYSQL_DATABASE:luckyhub}?useUnicode=true&characterEncoding=UTF-8&serverTimezone=Asia/Shanghai&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true&useSSL=false
    username: ${MYSQL_USER:luckyhub}
    password: ${MYSQL_PASSWORD:${LUCKYHUB_DB_PASSWORD:}}
  flyway:
    enabled: true
    locations: classpath:db/migration
    validate-on-migrate: true
    clean-disabled: true
  data:
    redis:
      host: ${REDIS_HOST:localhost}
      port: ${REDIS_PORT:6379}
      password: ${REDIS_PASSWORD}
      database: 0
      timeout: 3s
  rabbitmq:
    host: ${RABBITMQ_HOST:localhost}
    port: ${RABBITMQ_PORT:5672}
    username: ${RABBITMQ_USERNAME:}
    password: ${RABBITMQ_PASSWORD:}
    virtual-host: ${RABBITMQ_VHOST:/dongqh}
    publisher-confirm-type: correlated
    publisher-returns: true
    template:
      mandatory: true
    listener:
      simple:
        acknowledge-mode: auto
        default-requeue-rejected: false
        retry:
          enabled: true
          max-retries: 2
          initial-interval: 500ms
          multiplier: 2
          max-interval: 2s
  servlet:
    multipart:
      max-file-size: 6MB
      max-request-size: 6MB

mybatis-plus:
  configuration:
    map-underscore-to-camel-case: true

seata:
  enabled: ${SEATA_ENABLED:true}
  application-id: ${spring.application.name}
  tx-service-group: hmall_tx_group
  enable-auto-data-source-proxy: true
  data-source-proxy-mode: AT
  service:
    vgroup-mapping:
      hmall_tx_group: default
  registry:
    type: nacos
    nacos:
      application: seata-server
      server-addr: ${NACOS_SERVER_ADDR:127.0.0.1:18848}
      group: DEFAULT_GROUP
      namespace: ""
      cluster: default
      username: ${NACOS_USERNAME:nacos}
      password: ${NACOS_PASSWORD:nacos}

springdoc:
  api-docs:
    path: /v3/api-docs
  swagger-ui:
    path: /swagger-ui.html

luckyhub:
  integration:
    hmall:
      catalog-base-url: ${HMALL_ITEM_BASE_URL:http://localhost:8081}
      address-base-url: ${HMALL_USER_BASE_URL:http://localhost:8083}
  shipping:
    address-key: ${SHIPPING_ADDRESS_KEY}
    address-key-version: v1
    claim-period: 7d
    callback-secret: ${SHIPPING_CALLBACK_SECRET}
    callback-window: 5m
    expiry-interval: 1m
    expiry-initial-delay: 60s
    batch-size: 50
  lottery:
    zone-id: Asia/Shanghai
    lock-wait: 3s
    processing-timeout: 2m
    reconcile-interval: 30s
    reconcile-initial-delay: 60s
    reconcile-batch-size: 100
    reconciliation-enabled: true
    outbox-interval: 5s
    outbox-initial-delay: 60s
    outbox-batch-size: 100
  messaging:
    enabled: true
    logical-consumer-name: lottery-core
    publisher-confirm-timeout: 5s
    outbox-lease: 30s
  activity:
    status-refresh-interval: ${ACTIVITY_STATUS_REFRESH_INTERVAL:30000}
    status-refresh-initial-delay: ${ACTIVITY_STATUS_REFRESH_INITIAL_DELAY:0}
  oss:
    enabled: ${OSS_ENABLED:false}
    region: ${OSS_REGION:}
    endpoint: ${OSS_ENDPOINT:}
    bucket: ${OSS_BUCKET:}
    access-key-id: ${OSS_ACCESS_KEY_ID:}
    access-key-secret: ${OSS_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET:}
    public-base-url: ${OSS_PUBLIC_BASE_URL:}
  security:
    hmall-jwt:
      public-key: classpath:hmall-public.pem
    password:
      bcrypt-strength: ${BCRYPT_STRENGTH:12}
    jwt:
      secret: ${JWT_SECRET}
      expiration: ${JWT_EXPIRATION}
  fulfillment:
    base-delay: 1s
    max-delay: 1m
    lease-duration: 30s
    poll-interval: 5s
    initial-delay: 60s
    compensation-grace: 30s
    outbox-interval: 5s
    outbox-initial-delay: 60s
    batch-size: 50
    recovery-batch-size: 50
    outbox-batch-size: 100
    projection-interval: 5s
    projection-initial-delay: 60s

CREATE TABLE sys_user (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '用户名',
    password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT '加密密码',
    nickname VARCHAR(50) NULL COMMENT '昵称',
    status TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '用户状态：0-禁用，1-启用',
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '修改时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_sys_user_username (username),
    KEY idx_sys_user_status (status),
    CONSTRAINT chk_sys_user_status CHECK (status IN (0, 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='系统用户表';

CREATE TABLE sys_role (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    role_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '角色编码',
    role_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '角色名称',
    status TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '状态：0-禁用，1-启用',
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_sys_role_role_code (role_code),
    KEY idx_sys_role_status (status),
    CONSTRAINT chk_sys_role_status CHECK (status IN (0, 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='角色表';

CREATE TABLE sys_permission (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    permission_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '权限编码',
    permission_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '权限名称',
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_sys_permission_code (permission_code)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='权限表';

CREATE TABLE sys_user_role (
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '用户ID',
    role_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '角色ID',
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role_id),
    KEY idx_sys_user_role_role_id (role_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='用户角色关联表';

CREATE TABLE sys_role_permission (
    role_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '角色ID',
    permission_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '权限ID',
    PRIMARY KEY (role_id, permission_id),
    KEY idx_sys_role_permission_permission_id (permission_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='角色权限关联表';

CREATE TABLE marketing_prize (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    prize_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '奖品名称',
    prize_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL COMMENT '奖品类型',
    prize_level VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL COMMENT '奖品等级',
    image_url VARCHAR(500) NULL COMMENT '图片地址',
    description VARCHAR(500) NULL COMMENT '奖品说明',
    stackable TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '是否可叠加：0-否，1-是',
    status TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '状态：0-禁用，1-启用',
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '修改时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    KEY idx_marketing_prize_type (prize_type),
    KEY idx_marketing_prize_status (status),
    CONSTRAINT chk_marketing_prize_stackable CHECK (stackable IN (0, 1)),
    CONSTRAINT chk_marketing_prize_status CHECK (status IN (0, 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='奖品表';

CREATE TABLE marketing_activity (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    activity_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '活动名称',
    description VARCHAR(1000) NULL COMMENT '活动说明',
    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' COMMENT '活动状态',
    start_time DATETIME(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '开始时间',
    end_time DATETIME(3) NOT NULL COMMENT '结束时间',
    daily_limit INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '用户每日参与次数上限',
    created_by BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '创建人ID',
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '修改时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    KEY idx_marketing_activity_status (status),
    KEY idx_marketing_activity_start_time (start_time),
    KEY idx_marketing_activity_end_time (end_time),
    KEY idx_marketing_activity_name (activity_name),
    KEY idx_marketing_activity_created_by (created_by),
    CONSTRAINT chk_marketing_activity_time CHECK (end_time > start_time),
    CONSTRAINT chk_marketing_activity_daily_limit CHECK (daily_limit > 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='营销活动表';

CREATE TABLE marketing_activity_prize (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    activity_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '活动ID',
    prize_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '奖品ID',
    weight INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '中奖权重',
    total_stock INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '总库存',
    remaining_stock INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '数据库剩余库存',
    sort_order INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '展示顺序',
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '修改时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_activity_prize (activity_id, prize_id),
    KEY idx_activity_prize_prize_id (prize_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_activity_prize_weight CHECK (weight > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_activity_prize_stock CHECK (remaining_stock <= total_stock)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='活动奖品表';

CREATE TABLE lottery_draw_order (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    request_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '请求唯一标识',
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '用户ID',
    activity_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '活动ID',
    draw_count INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '抽奖次数',

    fail_reason VARCHAR(500) NULL COMMENT '失败原因',
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) COMMENT '创建时间',
    completed_at DATETIME(3) NULL COMMENT '完成时间',
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_lottery_draw_order_request_id (request_id),
    KEY idx_draw_order_user_id (user_id),
    KEY idx_draw_order_activity_id (activity_id),
    KEY idx_draw_order_status (status),
    KEY idx_draw_order_created_at (created_at),

CREATE TABLE lottery_draw_record (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    order_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '抽奖订单ID',
    request_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '请求ID',

    KEY idx_draw_record_draw_time (draw_time),
    CONSTRAINT chk_draw_record_sequence CHECK (sequence_no > 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='中奖记录表';

CREATE TABLE user_benefit (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键',
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '用户ID',
    prize_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL COMMENT '奖品ID',

INSERT INTO sys_permission (permission_code, permission_name)
SELECT seed.permission_code, seed.permission_name
FROM (
    SELECT 'points:read' AS permission_code, '查询本人积分与兑换记录' AS permission_name
    UNION ALL SELECT 'points:redeem', '创建积分兑换'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'points:adjust', '管理积分调整与兑换冲正'
) seed
LEFT JOIN sys_permission existing_permission
    ON existing_permission.permission_code = seed.permission_code
WHERE existing_permission.id IS NULL;

INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id)
SELECT role_record.id, permission.id
FROM sys_role role_record
JOIN sys_permission permission ON permission.permission_code IN ('points:read', 'points:redeem')
LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission existing_relation
    ON existing_relation.role_id = role_record.id
    AND existing_relation.permission_id = permission.id
WHERE role_record.role_code IN ('USER', 'ADMIN')
  AND existing_relation.role_id IS NULL;

INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id)
SELECT admin_role.id, permission.id
FROM sys_role admin_role
JOIN sys_permission permission ON permission.permission_code = 'points:adjust'
LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission existing_relation
    ON existing_relation.role_id = admin_role.id
    AND existing_relation.permission_id = permission.id
WHERE admin_role.role_code = 'ADMIN'

    template_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    coupon_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    threshold_cent BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    discount_cent BIGINT NOT NULL,
    applicable_product_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    valid_from DATETIME(3) NOT NULL,
    valid_until DATETIME(3) NOT NULL,
    per_user_limit INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    stackable_with_membership TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,

    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),

    CONSTRAINT chk_coupon_template_period CHECK (valid_until > valid_from),
    CONSTRAINT chk_coupon_template_limit CHECK (per_user_limit > 0),

CREATE TABLE payment_order (

INSERT INTO sys_permission (permission_code, permission_name)
SELECT seed.permission_code, seed.permission_name FROM (
    SELECT 'coupon:read' permission_code, '查询本人优惠券' permission_name
    UNION ALL SELECT 'coupon:manage', '管理优惠券模板与发放'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'membership:read', '查询和购买会员'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'membership:manage', '管理会员产品'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order:create', '创建现金订单'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order:read', '查询本人现金订单'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'order:cancel', '取消本人现金订单'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'payment:create', '创建本人模拟支付单'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'payment:simulate', '模拟支付结果'
) seed LEFT JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_code = seed.permission_code
WHERE p.id IS NULL;

INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id)
SELECT r.id, p.id FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_code IN (
 'coupon:read','membership:read','order:create','order:read','order:cancel','payment:create')
LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id AND rp.permission_id=p.id
WHERE r.role_code IN ('USER','ADMIN') AND rp.role_id IS NULL;

INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id)
SELECT r.id, p.id FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_permission p ON p.permission_code IN (
 'coupon:manage','membership:manage','payment:simulate')
LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id AND rp.permission_id=p.id
WHERE r.role_code='ADMIN' AND rp.role_id IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE fulfillment_task (

    source_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    fulfillment_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    target_user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    request_payload JSON NOT NULL,
    request_fingerprint CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    attempt_count INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    max_attempts INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
    next_attempt_at DATETIME(3) NULL,
    lease_token VARCHAR(64) NULL,
    lease_until DATETIME(3) NULL,
    external_reference VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    last_error_category VARCHAR(30) NULL,
    last_error_code VARCHAR(64) NULL,
    last_error_message VARCHAR(500) NULL,
    completed_at DATETIME(3) NULL,
    version INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_fulfillment_task_no (fulfillment_no),
    KEY idx_fulfillment_task_due (status, next_attempt_at, id),

    KEY idx_fulfillment_task_source (source_type, source_id),

    CONSTRAINT chk_fulfillment_task_attempts CHECK (max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND attempt_count <= max_attempts)

CREATE TABLE fulfillment_attempt (

INSERT INTO sys_permission (permission_code, permission_name)
SELECT seed.permission_code, seed.permission_name
FROM (
    SELECT 'shipping:address:manage' AS permission_code, '管理本人收货地址' AS permission_name
    UNION ALL SELECT 'shipping:read', '查询本人物流信息'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'shipping:operate', '管理物流履约'
) seed
LEFT JOIN sys_permission existing_permission
    ON existing_permission.permission_code = seed.permission_code
WHERE existing_permission.id IS NULL;

INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id)
SELECT role_record.id, permission.id
FROM sys_role role_record
JOIN sys_permission permission
    ON permission.permission_code IN ('shipping:address:manage', 'shipping:read')
LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission existing_relation
    ON existing_relation.role_id = role_record.id
    AND existing_relation.permission_id = permission.id
WHERE role_record.role_code IN ('USER', 'ADMIN')
  AND existing_relation.role_id IS NULL;

INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id)
SELECT admin_role.id, permission.id
FROM sys_role admin_role
JOIN sys_permission permission ON permission.permission_code = 'shipping:operate'
LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission existing_relation
    ON existing_relation.role_id = admin_role.id
    AND existing_relation.permission_id = permission.id
WHERE admin_role.role_code = 'ADMIN'
  AND existing_relation.role_id IS NULL;

INSERT INTO sys_role (role_code, role_name, status)
SELECT 'ADMIN', '系统管理员', 1
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM sys_role
    WHERE role_code = 'ADMIN'
);

INSERT INTO sys_permission (permission_code, permission_name)
SELECT seed.permission_code, seed.permission_name
FROM (
    SELECT 'user:create' AS permission_code, '创建用户' AS permission_name
    UNION ALL SELECT 'user:read', '查询用户'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'role:create', '创建角色'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'role:read', '查询角色'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'permission:create', '创建权限'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'permission:read', '查询权限'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'user-role:assign', '分配用户角色'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'user-role:read', '查询用户角色'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'role-permission:assign', '分配角色权限'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'role-permission:read', '查询角色权限'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'user-permission:read', '查询用户最终权限'
) AS seed
LEFT JOIN sys_permission AS existing_permission
    ON existing_permission.permission_code = seed.permission_code
WHERE existing_permission.id IS NULL;

INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id)
SELECT admin_role.id, base_permission.id
FROM sys_role AS admin_role
JOIN sys_permission AS base_permission
    ON base_permission.permission_code IN (
        'user:create',
        'user:read',
        'role:create',
        'role:read',
        'permission:create',
        'permission:read',
        'user-role:assign',
        'user-role:read',
        'role-permission:assign',
        'role-permission:read',
        'user-permission:read'
    )
LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission AS existing_relation
    ON existing_relation.role_id = admin_role.id
    AND existing_relation.permission_id = base_permission.id
WHERE admin_role.role_code = 'ADMIN'
  AND existing_relation.role_id IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE membership_product (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    product_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    product_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    membership_level VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    card_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    duration_days INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    price_cent BIGINT NOT NULL,
    discount_basis_points INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    daily_draw_bonus INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    points_multiplier_basis_points INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 10000,
    status TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_membership_product_code (product_code),
    CONSTRAINT chk_membership_card_type CHECK (card_type IN ('MONTH','QUARTER','YEAR')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_membership_product_values CHECK (duration_days > 0 AND price_cent >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_membership_discount CHECK (discount_basis_points BETWEEN 1 AND 10000),
    CONSTRAINT chk_membership_multiplier CHECK (points_multiplier_basis_points >= 10000),
    CONSTRAINT chk_membership_product_status CHECK (status IN (0,1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='会员产品';

CREATE TABLE user_membership (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    membership_level VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    starts_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL,
    expires_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL,
    discount_basis_points INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    daily_draw_bonus INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    points_multiplier_basis_points INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    version INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_user_membership_user (user_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_user_membership_period CHECK (expires_at > starts_at),
    CONSTRAINT chk_user_membership_discount CHECK (discount_basis_points BETWEEN 1 AND 10000)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='用户会员';

CREATE TABLE membership_grant_record (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    business_no VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    membership_product_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    starts_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL,
    expires_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_membership_grant_business (business_no),
    KEY idx_membership_grant_user (user_id, created_at, id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='会员发放幂等历史';

-- Durable transactional outbox for trade-service domain events.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `hm_trade`.`trade_message_outbox` (
    `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    `event_id` VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    `event_type` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    `aggregate_id` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    `payload` JSON NOT NULL,
    `status` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    `retry_count` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    `last_error` VARCHAR(500) NULL,
    `claim_token` VARCHAR(36) NULL,
    `next_retry_at` DATETIME(3) NULL,
    `created_at` DATETIME(3) NOT NULL,
    `sent_at` DATETIME(3) NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
    UNIQUE KEY `uk_trade_outbox_event_id` (`event_id`),
    KEY `idx_trade_outbox_relay` (`status`, `next_retry_at`, `id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='trade-service transactional message outbox';

-- Durable transactional outbox for pay-service domain events.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `hm_pay`.`pay_message_outbox` (
    `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    `event_id` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    `event_type` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    `aggregate_id` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    `payload` JSON NOT NULL,
    `status` VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    `retry_count` INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    `last_error` VARCHAR(500) NULL,
    `claim_token` VARCHAR(64) NULL,
    `next_retry_at` DATETIME(3) NULL,
    `created_at` DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    `sent_at` DATETIME(3) NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
    UNIQUE KEY `uk_pay_outbox_event_id` (`event_id`),
    KEY `idx_pay_outbox_relay` (`status`, `next_retry_at`, `id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='pay-service transactional message outbox';

-- Membership purchases are owned by Trade; this table stores the immutable paid-terms snapshot.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `hm_trade`.`trade_membership_order` (
    `id` BIGINT NOT NULL,
    `user_id` BIGINT NOT NULL,
    `request_key` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    `membership_product_id` BIGINT NOT NULL,
    `product_code` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    `product_name` VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    `membership_level` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    `duration_days` INT NOT NULL,
    `total_fee` INT NOT NULL,
    `discount_basis_points` INT NOT NULL,
    `daily_draw_bonus` INT NOT NULL,
    `points_multiplier_basis_points` INT NOT NULL,
    `status` TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '1 unpaid, 2 paid, 5 closed',
    `paid_at` DATETIME(3) NULL,
    `created_at` DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    `updated_at` DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
        ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
    UNIQUE KEY `uk_trade_membership_user_request` (`user_id`, `request_key`),
    KEY `idx_trade_membership_user_created` (`user_id`, `created_at`, `id`),
    KEY `idx_trade_membership_status_created` (`status`, `created_at`, `id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Trade-owned membership purchase and immutable price/term snapshot';

-- A side table keeps the existing Trade pay_order schema and queries unchanged.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `hm_pay`.`pay_order_domain` (
    `pay_order_id` BIGINT NOT NULL,
    `biz_order_no` BIGINT NOT NULL,
    `order_domain` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
    `created_at` DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (`pay_order_id`),
    UNIQUE KEY `uk_pay_domain_business_order` (`order_domain`, `biz_order_no`),
    KEY `idx_pay_domain_business_order` (`biz_order_no`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='Pay-service business order domain extension';

-- One-time, idempotent cutover from the retired luckyhub marketing schema.
-- User-owned rows are copied only when the legacy hmall:{id} projection has
-- a matching user in hm_user. This deliberately excludes orphan projections.

USE hm_lottery;

START TRANSACTION;

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE verified_hmall_user (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY
) ENGINE=MEMORY;

INSERT INTO verified_hmall_user (id)
SELECT legacy_user.id
FROM luckyhub.sys_user legacy_user
JOIN hm_user.`user` hmall_user ON hmall_user.id = legacy_user.id
WHERE legacy_user.username = CONCAT('hmall:', legacy_user.id);

-- Coupon domain
INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_coupon.coupon_template
SELECT * FROM luckyhub.coupon_template;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_coupon.user_coupon
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.user_coupon source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.user_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_coupon.coupon_issue_record
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.coupon_issue_record source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.user_id
JOIN hm_coupon.user_coupon migrated_coupon ON migrated_coupon.id = source_row.user_coupon_id;

-- Membership domain
INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_membership.membership_product
SELECT * FROM luckyhub.membership_product;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_membership.user_membership
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.user_membership source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.user_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_membership.membership_grant_record
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.membership_grant_record source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.user_id;

-- Points domain. The legacy database currently has no redemption orders; its
-- old order shape is intentionally not inserted into the newer workflow table.
INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_points.points_redemption_offer
SELECT * FROM luckyhub.points_redemption_offer;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_points.points_account
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.points_account source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.user_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_points.points_ledger
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.points_ledger source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.user_id;

-- Lottery catalog
INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_lottery.reward_definition
SELECT * FROM luckyhub.reward_definition;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_lottery.marketing_prize
SELECT * FROM luckyhub.marketing_prize;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_lottery.marketing_activity
SELECT * FROM luckyhub.marketing_activity;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_lottery.marketing_activity_prize
SELECT * FROM luckyhub.marketing_activity_prize;

-- Lottery user state and history
INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_lottery.draw_chance_account
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.draw_chance_account source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.user_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_lottery.draw_chance_ledger
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.draw_chance_ledger source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.user_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_lottery.draw_chance_reservation
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.draw_chance_reservation source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.user_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_lottery.lottery_draw_order
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.lottery_draw_order source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.user_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_lottery.lottery_draw_record
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.lottery_draw_record source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.user_id
JOIN hm_lottery.lottery_draw_order migrated_order ON migrated_order.id = source_row.order_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_lottery.user_benefit
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.user_benefit source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.user_id
JOIN hm_lottery.lottery_draw_record migrated_record ON migrated_record.id = source_row.draw_record_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_lottery.lottery_reward_quarantine
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.lottery_reward_quarantine source_row
WHERE (source_row.order_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM hm_lottery.lottery_draw_order migrated_order
         WHERE migrated_order.id = source_row.order_id
      ))
  AND (source_row.draw_record_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM hm_lottery.lottery_draw_record migrated_record
         WHERE migrated_record.id = source_row.draw_record_id
      ))
  AND (source_row.benefit_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM hm_lottery.user_benefit migrated_benefit
         WHERE migrated_benefit.id = source_row.benefit_id
      ));

-- Preserve completed messaging history without replaying pending legacy work.
INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_lottery.message_outbox
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.message_outbox source_row
WHERE source_row.status IN ('SENT', 'FAILED');

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_lottery.message_consume_record
SELECT * FROM luckyhub.message_consume_record;

-- Fulfillment domain
INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_fulfillment.fulfillment_task
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.fulfillment_task source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.target_user_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_fulfillment.fulfillment_attempt
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.fulfillment_attempt source_row
JOIN hm_fulfillment.fulfillment_task migrated_task ON migrated_task.id = source_row.task_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_fulfillment.fulfillment_quarantine
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.fulfillment_quarantine source_row
JOIN hm_fulfillment.fulfillment_task migrated_task ON migrated_task.id = source_row.task_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_fulfillment.fulfillment_outbox
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.fulfillment_outbox source_row
JOIN hm_fulfillment.fulfillment_task migrated_task
  ON migrated_task.fulfillment_no = source_row.fulfillment_no
WHERE source_row.status IN ('SENT', 'FAILED');

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_fulfillment.shipping_address_snapshot
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.shipping_address_snapshot source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.user_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_fulfillment.shipping_order
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.shipping_order source_row
JOIN verified_hmall_user verified_user ON verified_user.id = source_row.target_user_id
JOIN hm_fulfillment.shipping_address_snapshot migrated_snapshot
  ON migrated_snapshot.id = source_row.address_snapshot_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_fulfillment.shipping_tracking_event
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.shipping_tracking_event source_row
JOIN hm_fulfillment.shipping_order migrated_order
  ON migrated_order.id = source_row.shipping_order_id;

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_fulfillment.shipping_callback_receipt
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.shipping_callback_receipt source_row
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hm_fulfillment.shipping_order migrated_order
    WHERE migrated_order.waybill_no = source_row.waybill_no
);

INSERT IGNORE INTO hm_fulfillment.sim_logistics_record
SELECT source_row.*
FROM luckyhub.sim_logistics_record source_row
JOIN hm_fulfillment.shipping_order migrated_order
  ON migrated_order.fulfillment_no = source_row.fulfillment_no;

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE verified_hmall_user;

COMMIT;

USE `seata`;

SET @seata_db_password = COALESCE(@seata_db_password, 'change-seata-db-password');
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'seata_app'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY 'temporary-password-replaced-below';
SET @alter_seata_user = CONCAT(
  'ALTER USER ''seata_app''@''%'' IDENTIFIED BY ',
  QUOTE(@seata_db_password)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `global_table`
(
    `xid`                       VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    `transaction_id`            BIGINT,
    `status`                    TINYINT      NOT NULL,
    `application_id`            VARCHAR(32),
    `transaction_service_group` VARCHAR(32),
    `transaction_name`          VARCHAR(128),
    `timeout`                   INT,
    `begin_time`                BIGINT,
    `application_data`          VARCHAR(2000),
    `gmt_create`                DATETIME,
    `gmt_modified`              DATETIME,
    PRIMARY KEY (`xid`),
    KEY `idx_status_gmt_modified` (`status` , `gmt_modified`),
    KEY `idx_transaction_id` (`transaction_id`)
) ENGINE = InnoDB
  DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4;


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `branch_table`
(
    `branch_id`         BIGINT       NOT NULL,
    `xid`               VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    `transaction_id`    BIGINT,
    `resource_group_id` VARCHAR(32),
    `resource_id`       VARCHAR(256),
    `branch_type`       VARCHAR(8),
    `status`            TINYINT,
    `client_id`         VARCHAR(64),
    `application_data`  VARCHAR(2000),
    `gmt_create`        DATETIME(6),
    `gmt_modified`      DATETIME(6),
    PRIMARY KEY (`branch_id`),
    KEY `idx_xid` (`xid`)
) ENGINE = InnoDB
  DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4;


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `lock_table`
(
    `row_key`        VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    `xid`            VARCHAR(128),
    `transaction_id` BIGINT,
    `branch_id`      BIGINT       NOT NULL,
    `resource_id`    VARCHAR(256),
    `table_name`     VARCHAR(32),
    `pk`             VARCHAR(36),
    `status`         TINYINT      NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '0:locked ,1:rollbacking',
    `gmt_create`     DATETIME,
    `gmt_modified`   DATETIME,
    PRIMARY KEY (`row_key`),
    KEY `idx_status` (`status`),
    KEY `idx_branch_id` (`branch_id`),
    KEY `idx_xid_and_branch_id` (`xid` , `branch_id`)
) ENGINE = InnoDB
  DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `distributed_lock`
(

CREATE TABLE points_account (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    balance BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    version INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_points_account_user (user_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_points_account_balance CHECK (balance >= 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='用户积分账户';

CREATE TABLE points_ledger (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    business_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    business_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    direction VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
    amount BIGINT NOT NULL,
    balance_after BIGINT NOT NULL,
    reversal_of_ledger_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    remark VARCHAR(500) NULL,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_points_ledger_business (business_type, business_id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_points_ledger_reversal (reversal_of_ledger_id),
    KEY idx_points_ledger_user_created (user_id, created_at, id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_points_ledger_business_type CHECK (
        business_type IN ('LOTTERY_REWARD', 'ORDER_REWARD', 'MEMBERSHIP_BONUS',
                          'REDEMPTION', 'REVERSAL', 'MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT')
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_points_ledger_direction CHECK (direction IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_points_ledger_amount CHECK (amount > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_points_ledger_balance CHECK (balance_after >= 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='不可变积分流水';

CREATE TABLE points_redemption_offer (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    hmall_item_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    unit_points BIGINT NOT NULL,
    available_stock INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    item_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    image_url VARCHAR(500) NULL,
    cash_price_cent INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    status TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_points_offer_hmall_item (hmall_item_id),
    KEY idx_points_offer_status_stock (status, available_stock, id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_points_offer_points CHECK (unit_points > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_points_offer_stock CHECK (available_stock <= 1000000),
    CONSTRAINT chk_points_offer_status CHECK (status IN (0, 1))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Hmall商品积分兑换报价';

CREATE TABLE points_redemption_order (
    id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
    redemption_no VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    sku_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    offer_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    hmall_item_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    quantity INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    unit_points BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    total_points BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
    cash_price_cent INT UNSIGNED NULL,
    product_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    product_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    sku_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    sku_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    product_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    image_url VARCHAR(500) NULL,
    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    process_step VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    request_fingerprint CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    address_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    shipping_order_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL,
    reversal_no VARCHAR(64) NULL,
    failure_reason VARCHAR(500) NULL,
    original_error_code VARCHAR(64) NULL,
    created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    updated_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_points_redemption_no (redemption_no),
    UNIQUE KEY uk_points_redemption_reversal (reversal_no),
    KEY idx_points_redemption_user_created (user_id, created_at, id),
    KEY idx_points_redemption_shipping_order (shipping_order_id),
    CONSTRAINT chk_points_redemption_quantity CHECK (quantity > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_points_redemption_price CHECK (unit_points > 0 AND total_points > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_points_redemption_type CHECK (product_type IN ('PHYSICAL', 'VIRTUAL')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_points_redemption_status CHECK (
        status IN ('PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'COMPENSATED', 'REVERSED')
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_points_redemption_source CHECK (
        (sku_id IS NOT NULL AND offer_id IS NULL AND hmall_item_id IS NULL)
        OR (sku_id IS NULL AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND hmall_item_id IS NOT NULL)
    ),
    CONSTRAINT chk_points_redemption_address CHECK (
        (product_type = 'PHYSICAL' AND address_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (product_type = 'VIRTUAL' AND address_id IS NULL)
    )
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='积分兑换单';

# HMall Lottery 融合工程

本目录是黑马商城与 LuckyHub 营销核心的隔离融合工作区，原始四个来源目录保持不变。

## 当前目录

- `mall-backend/`：黑马商城 Java 后端原始副本（`hm-common` + `hm-service`）。
- `marketing-service/`：LuckyHub Java 17 后端源码快照，后续只保留并适配营销核心。
- `mysql/`：黑马商城原始 MySQL 配置和初始化数据。
- `nginx/`：黑马商城 Portal/Admin 静态前端和 Nginx 配置。
- `tests/`：融合工作区结构与集成契约测试。

## 本地运行与验证

本仓库统一使用 JDK 17、Spring Boot 4.0.8 和 Maven 3.9+。运行 `mvn -version` 时必须显示 Java 17；IDEA 的 Project SDK、Maven Runner JRE 和各 Spring Boot 运行配置也应选择 JDK 17。

在仓库根目录执行全仓编译：

```powershell
mvn -B -ntp clean test-compile -DskipTests
```

先根据 `.env.example` 准备被 Git 忽略的 `.env`，并为数据库、Redis、JWT 和地址加密配置真实的本地开发值。默认启动命令会运行商品、购物车、用户、交易和支付五个拆分服务，以及商城网关、Marketing、Nacos、MySQL、Redis 和 Nginx。Nginx 将商城 API 转发到网关，由网关校验登录令牌并向业务服务传递用户身份。Nginx rewrites `/api/marketing/**` to the existing backend `/api/**` path and forwards Marketing APIs to `hm-gateway`; the Gateway temporarily routes unmigrated APIs to `marketing-service`. The exact `/api/marketing/auth/login` path remains on Marketing until `user-service` provides the compatible RS256 login response. As each domain is extracted, its explicit Nacos route takes precedence over the Gateway fallback.

```powershell
docker compose --env-file .env up --build -d
```

容器启动并健康后，通过 Portal/Admin 静态页、登录以及各服务边界执行冒烟验证：

```powershell
pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Smoke-Test.ps1
```

如需单独启动旧单体进行回滚诊断，可启用 `rollback` profile：

```powershell
docker compose --env-file .env --profile rollback up --build -d mall-service
```

该回滚命令只启动 `mall-service`。Nginx 仍按默认配置把商城接口路由到网关和五个拆分服务；只有在明确恢复旧 Nginx 配置后，流量才会重新进入单体。

## Seata TC

默认 Docker 栈会初始化 `seata` 数据库，并启动基于
`apache/seata-server:2.5.0.jdk17` 构建的 TC。MySQL、Nacos、Seata 和各业务服务
统一通过 `hmall-lottery_default` 网络通信。当前 2.5 运行镜像以非 Web 模式启动 TC，
事务通信使用容器内 `8091` 端口，并映射到宿主机 `18091`；不提供内置 Web 控制台。

Start or refresh only the TC infrastructure:

```powershell
docker compose --env-file .env up -d --build seata-server
docker compose ps mysql nacos seata-server
docker compose logs --tail 100 seata-server
```

宿主机上的 TC RPC 地址为 `localhost:18091`。TC 在 `seata` 数据库中使用
`global_table`、`branch_table`、`lock_table`、
`distributed_lock` 和 `vgroup_table`。

商品、购物车、用户、交易、支付和 Marketing 六个服务均已接入 Seata AT 客户端，
统一使用事务组 `hmall_tx_group`，并通过 Nacos 发现 `seata-server`。五个 HMall 业务库
由初始化迁移创建各自的 `undo_log`，Marketing 则由 Flyway V27 创建该表。
交易创建、结算优惠券、订单取消和余额支付是当前全局事务入口；AT 只回滚同一 XID
下的关系型数据库写入，Redis、消息队列、Outbox 及外部 HTTP 副作用仍需业务补偿或最终一致性处理。

## 来源

- LuckyHub：`E:\ANotes\software\luckyhub`
- 黑马商城：`E:\ANotes\后端\后端开发\SpringCloud微服务—资料\day02-Docker\资料\hmall - 副本`
- MySQL：`E:\ANotes\后端\后端开发\SpringCloud微服务—资料\day02-Docker\资料\mysql - 副本`
- Nginx：`E:\ANotes\后端\后端开发\SpringCloud微服务—资料\day02-Docker\资料\nginx - 副本`

> LuckyHub 来源分支为 `feature/frontend-contract-remediation`，复制时来源工作树已有修改和未跟踪文件。本仓库提交保存的是实际工作树快照，不等同于来源仓库 HEAD。

-- Product and SKU status distribution.
SELECT VERSION() AS mysql_server_version;

SELECT 'product_status' AS metric, CAST(status AS CHAR) AS dimension, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM luckyhub.product
GROUP BY status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'product_sku_status', CAST(status AS CHAR), COUNT(*)
FROM luckyhub.product_sku
GROUP BY status;

-- Whether product_sku contains an explicit HMall item reference; do not infer one by matching text.
SELECT 'product_sku_direct_item_link_columns' AS metric,
       COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_schema = 'luckyhub'
  AND table_name = 'product_sku'
  AND column_name IN ('item_id', 'hmall_item_id');

-- Catalog sales-mode distribution, without returning price or SKU values.
SELECT 'product_sku_sale_mode' AS metric,
       CONCAT(cash_enabled, ':', points_enabled) AS dimension,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM luckyhub.product_sku
GROUP BY cash_enabled, points_enabled;

-- Ledger identity shape and aggregate orphan counts.
SELECT 'inventory_ledger_identity_shape' AS metric,
       CASE
           WHEN sku_id IS NOT NULL AND hmall_item_id IS NULL THEN 'marketing_sku_only'
           WHEN sku_id IS NULL AND hmall_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'hmall_item_only'
           WHEN sku_id IS NULL AND hmall_item_id IS NULL THEN 'both_null'
           ELSE 'both_present'
       END AS dimension,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM luckyhub.inventory_ledger
GROUP BY dimension;

SELECT 'inventory_ledger_missing_marketing_sku' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count
FROM luckyhub.inventory_ledger ledger
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.product_sku sku ON sku.id = ledger.sku_id
WHERE ledger.sku_id IS NOT NULL AND sku.id IS NULL;

SELECT 'inventory_ledger_missing_hmall_item' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count
FROM luckyhub.inventory_ledger ledger
LEFT JOIN hmall.item item ON item.id = ledger.hmall_item_id
WHERE ledger.hmall_item_id IS NOT NULL AND item.id IS NULL;

-- Reservation states and stored stock invariant anomalies.
SELECT 'inventory_reservation_status' AS metric, status AS dimension, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM luckyhub.inventory_reservation
GROUP BY status;

SELECT 'sku_inventory_allocation_exceeds_total' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count
FROM luckyhub.sku_inventory
WHERE allocated_stock > total_stock;

SELECT 'channel_stock_balance_mismatch' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count
FROM luckyhub.inventory_channel_stock
WHERE allocated_stock <> available_stock + reserved_stock + consumed_stock;

-- Target item population is an aggregate only; it does not assert a Marketing SKU mapping.
SELECT 'hmall_item_total' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count
FROM hmall.item;

-- Read-only aggregate preflight for coupon ownership and references.
-- Execute only with an already-confirmed SELECT-only account that can read
-- luckyhub, hmall, and information_schema. Do not export row-level results.
SELECT VERSION() AS mysql_server_version;

-- Required source tables present in luckyhub; names are fixed by this script.
SELECT 'required_luckyhub_coupon_tables_found' AS metric,

-- Coupon templates: only categorical status/type/scope dimensions.
SELECT 'coupon_template_total' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count

SELECT 'coupon_template_status' AS metric,

GROUP BY status;

SELECT 'coupon_template_scope_distribution' AS metric,

SELECT 'coupon_template_type_distribution' AS metric,

SELECT 'user_coupon_status' AS metric,

GROUP BY status;

SELECT 'user_coupon_total' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count

SELECT 'coupon_issue_record_total' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count

-- User, template, issue-record and order references; only aggregate counts leave the database.
SELECT 'user_coupon_missing_template' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count

LEFT JOIN luckyhub.coupon_template template ON template.id = coupon.template_id

SELECT 'user_coupon_missing_marketing_user' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count

WHERE account.id IS NULL;

SELECT 'coupon_issue_missing_template' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count

LEFT JOIN luckyhub.coupon_template template ON template.id = issue_record.template_id

SELECT 'coupon_issue_missing_user_coupon' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count

LEFT JOIN luckyhub.user_coupon coupon ON coupon.id = issue_record.user_coupon_id
