SELECT 'coupon_issue_missing_marketing_user' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count
FROM luckyhub.coupon_issue_record issue_record
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.sys_user account ON account.id = issue_record.user_id

SELECT 'coupon_issue_mapping_mismatch' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count

-- Return the number of duplicate idempotency-key groups, never the key values.
SELECT 'duplicate_coupon_issue_business_key_groups' AS metric,
       COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count
FROM (
    SELECT business_no
    FROM luckyhub.coupon_issue_record
    GROUP BY business_no
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT 'coupon_applied_order_status' AS metric,
       status AS dimension,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM luckyhub.mall_order
WHERE user_coupon_id IS NOT NULL OR coupon_template_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY status;

SELECT 'mall_order_missing_user_coupon' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count
FROM luckyhub.mall_order orders
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.user_coupon coupon ON coupon.id = orders.user_coupon_id
WHERE orders.user_coupon_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'mall_order_missing_coupon_template' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count
FROM luckyhub.mall_order orders
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.coupon_template template ON template.id = orders.coupon_template_id
WHERE orders.coupon_template_id IS NOT NULL
  AND template.id IS NULL;

SELECT 'mall_order_partial_coupon_reference' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count
FROM luckyhub.mall_order
WHERE (user_coupon_id IS NULL AND coupon_template_id IS NOT NULL)
   OR (user_coupon_id IS NOT NULL AND coupon_template_id IS NULL);

SELECT 'mall_order_coupon_mapping_mismatch' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count
FROM luckyhub.mall_order orders
JOIN luckyhub.user_coupon coupon ON coupon.id = orders.user_coupon_id
WHERE orders.user_coupon_id IS NOT NULL
  AND (orders.user_id <> coupon.user_id
       OR orders.coupon_template_id <> coupon.template_id);

SELECT 'coupon_template_scope_field_anomalies' AS metric,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN scope_type IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS null_scope_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN scope_type = 'ITEM' AND hmall_item_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS item_scope_missing_item_id,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN scope_type = 'CATEGORY' AND (hmall_category IS NULL OR TRIM(hmall_category) = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS category_scope_missing_category,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN scope_type = 'BRAND' AND (hmall_brand IS NULL OR TRIM(hmall_brand) = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS brand_scope_missing_brand,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN hmall_item_id IS NOT NULL AND (scope_type IS NULL OR scope_type <> 'ITEM') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS item_id_outside_item_scope
FROM luckyhub.coupon_template;

SELECT 'coupon_template_missing_hmall_item' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count
FROM luckyhub.coupon_template template
LEFT JOIN hmall.item item ON item.id = template.hmall_item_id
WHERE template.scope_type = 'ITEM'
  AND template.hmall_item_id IS NOT NULL
  AND item.id IS NULL;

-- Legacy Marketing product references are checked only against the source product table.
SELECT 'coupon_template_legacy_product_missing' AS metric, COUNT(*) AS aggregate_count
FROM luckyhub.coupon_template template
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.product product ON product.id = template.applicable_product_id
WHERE template.applicable_product_id IS NOT NULL
  AND product.id IS NULL;

-- Marketing identity and RBAC preflight audit.
-- Run with a MySQL account that has SELECT access only.
-- Detailed identity rows are transient review output and must not be committed.

-- Report the server version; mysql.exe --version reports only the client version.
SELECT VERSION() AS mysql_server_version;

-- User totals in both identity databases.
SELECT 'luckyhub.sys_user' AS identity_source, COUNT(*) AS user_count
  FROM luckyhub.sys_user
UNION ALL
SELECT 'hm_user.user' AS identity_source, COUNT(*) AS user_count
  FROM hm_user.user;

-- Status distributions. The two databases use different status encodings.
SELECT 'luckyhub.sys_user' AS identity_source, status, COUNT(*) AS user_count
  FROM luckyhub.sys_user
 GROUP BY status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'hm_user.user' AS identity_source, status, COUNT(*) AS user_count
  FROM hm_user.user
 GROUP BY status
 ORDER BY identity_source, status;

-- Marketing password format distribution only; no password value is returned.
SELECT CASE
           WHEN password REGEXP '^\\$2[aby]\\$[0-9]{2}\\$' THEN 'bcrypt'
           WHEN password = '!HMALL_EXTERNAL_IDENTITY!' THEN 'external_identity_marker'
           WHEN password IS NULL OR password = '' THEN 'empty'
           ELSE 'other'
       END AS password_format,
       COUNT(*) AS user_count
  FROM luckyhub.sys_user
 GROUP BY password_format
 ORDER BY password_format;

-- Aggregate identity conflict counts for the sanitized audit report.
SELECT 'same_id_different_username' AS conflict_type, COUNT(*) AS conflict_count
  FROM luckyhub.sys_user AS m
  JOIN hm_user.user AS h ON h.id = m.id
 WHERE m.username NOT LIKE CONCAT('hmall:', h.id)
   AND m.username <> h.username
UNION ALL
SELECT 'same_username_different_id' AS conflict_type, COUNT(*) AS conflict_count
  FROM luckyhub.sys_user AS m
  JOIN hm_user.user AS h ON h.username = m.username
 WHERE h.id <> m.id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'hmall_projection_missing_or_mismatched' AS conflict_type,
       COUNT(*) AS conflict_count
  FROM luckyhub.sys_user AS m
  LEFT JOIN hm_user.user AS h ON h.id = m.id
 WHERE m.username LIKE 'hmall:%'
   AND (h.id IS NULL OR m.username <> CONCAT('hmall:', m.id));

-- Detailed same-ID conflicts for controlled review only.
SELECT m.id AS marketing_user_id, m.username AS marketing_username,
       h.id AS hmall_user_id, h.username AS hmall_username
  FROM luckyhub.sys_user AS m
  JOIN hm_user.user AS h ON h.id = m.id
 WHERE m.username NOT LIKE CONCAT('hmall:', h.id)
   AND m.username <> h.username
 ORDER BY m.id;

-- Detailed same-username conflicts for controlled review only.
SELECT m.id AS marketing_user_id, m.username AS marketing_username,
       h.id AS hmall_user_id
  FROM luckyhub.sys_user AS m
  JOIN hm_user.user AS h ON h.username = m.username
 WHERE h.id <> m.id
 ORDER BY m.username, m.id;

-- Marketing hmall:{id} projections must have the same ID in hm_user.user.
SELECT m.id AS marketing_user_id, m.username AS marketing_username,
       h.id AS hmall_user_id
  FROM luckyhub.sys_user AS m
  LEFT JOIN hm_user.user AS h ON h.id = m.id
 WHERE m.username LIKE 'hmall:%'
   AND (h.id IS NULL OR m.username <> CONCAT('hmall:', m.id))
 ORDER BY m.id;

-- Aggregate orphan counts for all RBAC relationships.
SELECT 'sys_user_role.user_id' AS relationship_type,
       COUNT(*) AS orphan_count
  FROM luckyhub.sys_user_role AS ur
  LEFT JOIN luckyhub.sys_user AS u ON u.id = ur.user_id
 WHERE u.id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sys_user_role.role_id' AS relationship_type,
       COUNT(*) AS orphan_count
  FROM luckyhub.sys_user_role AS ur
  LEFT JOIN luckyhub.sys_role AS r ON r.id = ur.role_id
 WHERE r.id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sys_role_permission.role_id' AS relationship_type,
       COUNT(*) AS orphan_count
  FROM luckyhub.sys_role_permission AS rp
  LEFT JOIN luckyhub.sys_role AS r ON r.id = rp.role_id
 WHERE r.id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sys_role_permission.permission_id' AS relationship_type,
       COUNT(*) AS orphan_count
  FROM luckyhub.sys_role_permission AS rp
  LEFT JOIN luckyhub.sys_permission AS p ON p.id = rp.permission_id
 WHERE p.id IS NULL;

-- Structural inventory only; this does not validate row-level user mappings.
SELECT table_name, column_name
  FROM information_schema.columns
 WHERE table_schema = 'luckyhub'
   AND column_name = 'user_id'
 ORDER BY table_name;

SELECT UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS audit_execution_utc;

SELECT VERSION() AS mysql_server_version;

SELECT expected.table_schema,
       expected.table_name,
       CASE WHEN actual.table_name IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS table_present
FROM (
    SELECT 'luckyhub' AS table_schema, 'membership_product' AS table_name
    UNION ALL SELECT 'luckyhub', 'user_membership'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'luckyhub', 'membership_grant_record'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'luckyhub', 'sys_user'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'luckyhub', 'reward_definition'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'luckyhub', 'lottery_draw_record'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'luckyhub', 'user_benefit'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'hm_user', 'user'
) expected
LEFT JOIN information_schema.tables actual
    ON actual.table_schema = expected.table_schema
    AND actual.table_name = expected.table_name
ORDER BY expected.table_schema, expected.table_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS membership_product_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(status = 1), 0) AS enabled_product_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(status = 0), 0) AS disabled_product_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(status NOT IN (0, 1) OR status IS NULL), 0) AS unexpected_product_status_total
FROM luckyhub.membership_product;

SELECT card_type,
       COUNT(*) AS product_total
FROM luckyhub.membership_product
GROUP BY card_type
ORDER BY card_type;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_membership_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), 0) AS active_membership_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), 0) AS expired_membership_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(expires_at <= starts_at), 0) AS invalid_period_total,
       (
           SELECT COUNT(*)
           FROM (
               SELECT COUNT(*) AS duplicate_group_size
               FROM luckyhub.user_membership
               GROUP BY user_id
               HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
           ) duplicate_users
       ) AS duplicate_user_groups
FROM luckyhub.user_membership;

SELECT membership_level,
       COUNT(*) AS user_membership_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), 0) AS active_membership_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), 0) AS expired_membership_total
FROM luckyhub.user_membership
GROUP BY membership_level
ORDER BY membership_level;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS membership_grant_record_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(expires_at <= starts_at), 0) AS invalid_grant_period_total,
       (
           SELECT COUNT(*)
           FROM (
               SELECT COUNT(*) AS duplicate_group_size
               FROM luckyhub.membership_grant_record
               GROUP BY business_no
               HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
           ) duplicate_business_keys
       ) AS duplicate_business_key_groups
FROM luckyhub.membership_grant_record;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN user_record.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS membership_missing_marketing_user_total
FROM luckyhub.user_membership membership_record
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.sys_user user_record ON user_record.id = membership_record.user_id;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN user_record.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS grant_missing_marketing_user_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN product.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS grant_missing_membership_product_total
FROM luckyhub.membership_grant_record grant_record
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.sys_user user_record ON user_record.id = grant_record.user_id
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.membership_product product ON product.id = grant_record.membership_product_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS membership_reward_definition_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(reward.target_id IS NULL), 0) AS reward_definition_missing_product_reference_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(reward.target_id IS NOT NULL AND product.id IS NULL), 0) AS reward_definition_orphan_product_reference_total
FROM luckyhub.reward_definition reward
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.membership_product product ON product.id = reward.target_id
WHERE reward.reward_type = 'MEMBERSHIP';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS lottery_membership_snapshot_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(draw_record.reward_target_id IS NULL OR product.id IS NULL), 0) AS lottery_snapshot_missing_product_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(draw_record.reward_payload IS NULL), 0) AS lottery_snapshot_missing_payload_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           draw_record.reward_payload IS NOT NULL
           AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(draw_record.reward_payload, '$.membershipProductId')) IS NULL
       ), 0) AS lottery_snapshot_missing_payload_product_id_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           draw_record.reward_payload IS NOT NULL
           AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(draw_record.reward_payload, '$.membershipProductId')) IS NOT NULL
           AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(draw_record.reward_payload, '$.membershipProductId')) AS UNSIGNED)
               <> draw_record.reward_target_id
       ), 0) AS lottery_snapshot_target_payload_mismatch_total
FROM luckyhub.lottery_draw_record draw_record
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.membership_product product ON product.id = draw_record.reward_target_id
WHERE draw_record.reward_type = 'MEMBERSHIP';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_benefit_membership_snapshot_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(benefit.reward_target_id IS NULL OR product.id IS NULL), 0) AS user_benefit_snapshot_missing_product_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(benefit.reward_payload IS NULL), 0) AS user_benefit_snapshot_missing_payload_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           benefit.reward_payload IS NOT NULL
           AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(benefit.reward_payload, '$.membershipProductId')) IS NULL
       ), 0) AS user_benefit_snapshot_missing_payload_product_id_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           benefit.reward_payload IS NOT NULL
           AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(benefit.reward_payload, '$.membershipProductId')) IS NOT NULL
           AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(benefit.reward_payload, '$.membershipProductId')) AS UNSIGNED)
               <> benefit.reward_target_id
       ), 0) AS user_benefit_snapshot_target_payload_mismatch_total
FROM luckyhub.user_benefit benefit
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.membership_product product ON product.id = benefit.reward_target_id
WHERE benefit.reward_type = 'MEMBERSHIP';

-- Read-only aggregate preflight for a future points-service extraction.
-- Confirm a pre-existing SELECT-only audit account can read luckyhub,
-- hm_item, and information_schema before running this file.
-- Review the table inventory first; stop if any required table is absent.

SELECT UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AS audit_execution_utc;

SELECT VERSION() AS mysql_server_version;

SELECT expected.table_schema,
       expected.table_name,
       CASE WHEN actual.table_name IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS table_present
FROM (
    SELECT 'luckyhub' AS table_schema, 'points_account' AS table_name
    UNION ALL SELECT 'luckyhub', 'points_ledger'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'luckyhub', 'points_redemption_order'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'luckyhub', 'points_redemption_offer'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'luckyhub', 'sys_user'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'luckyhub', 'product'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'luckyhub', 'product_sku'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'luckyhub', 'shipping_address_snapshot'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'luckyhub', 'shipping_order'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'hm_item', 'item'
) expected
LEFT JOIN information_schema.tables actual
    ON actual.table_schema = expected.table_schema
    AND actual.table_name = expected.table_name
ORDER BY expected.table_schema, expected.table_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS points_account_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(account_record.balance = 0), 0) AS zero_balance_account_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(account_record.balance > 0), 0) AS positive_balance_account_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(account_record.balance < 0), 0) AS negative_balance_account_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(user_record.id IS NULL), 0) AS account_missing_marketing_user_total,
       (
           SELECT COUNT(*)
           FROM (
               SELECT user_id
               FROM luckyhub.points_account
               GROUP BY user_id
               HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
           ) duplicate_accounts
       ) AS duplicate_account_user_groups
FROM luckyhub.points_account account_record
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.sys_user user_record ON user_record.id = account_record.user_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts_without_ledger_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(account_record.balance <> 0), 0) AS nonzero_accounts_without_ledger_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           latest_ledger.id IS NOT NULL
           AND account_record.balance <> latest_ledger.balance_after
       ), 0) AS account_latest_ledger_balance_mismatch_total
FROM luckyhub.points_account account_record
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ledger_user.user_id, MAX(ledger_user.id) AS latest_ledger_id
    FROM luckyhub.points_ledger ledger_user
    GROUP BY ledger_user.user_id
) latest_per_user ON latest_per_user.user_id = account_record.user_id
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.points_ledger latest_ledger
    ON latest_ledger.id = latest_per_user.latest_ledger_id;

SELECT ledger.business_type,
       ledger.direction,
       COUNT(*) AS ledger_entry_total
FROM luckyhub.points_ledger ledger
GROUP BY ledger.business_type, ledger.direction
ORDER BY ledger.business_type, ledger.direction;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS points_ledger_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(user_record.id IS NULL), 0) AS ledger_missing_marketing_user_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(account_record.user_id IS NULL), 0) AS ledger_missing_account_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(ledger.amount <= 0), 0) AS ledger_nonpositive_amount_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(ledger.balance_after < 0), 0) AS ledger_negative_balance_snapshot_total,
       (
           SELECT COUNT(*)
           FROM (
               SELECT business_type, business_id
               FROM luckyhub.points_ledger
               GROUP BY business_type, business_id
               HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
           ) duplicate_business_keys
       ) AS duplicate_ledger_business_key_groups
FROM luckyhub.points_ledger ledger
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.sys_user user_record ON user_record.id = ledger.user_id
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.points_account account_record ON account_record.user_id = ledger.user_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS reversal_entry_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           reversal.business_type = 'REVERSAL'
           AND reversal.reversal_of_ledger_id IS NULL
       ), 0) AS reversal_missing_original_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           reversal.reversal_of_ledger_id IS NOT NULL
           AND (
               reversal.business_type <> 'REVERSAL'
               OR reversal.direction <> 'CREDIT'
               OR original_ledger.id IS NULL
               OR original_ledger.business_type <> 'REDEMPTION'
               OR original_ledger.direction <> 'DEBIT'
               OR original_ledger.user_id <> reversal.user_id
               OR original_ledger.amount <> reversal.amount
           )
       ), 0) AS reversal_invalid_link_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           reversal.business_type = 'REVERSAL'
           AND reversal.reversal_of_ledger_id IS NOT NULL
           AND original_ledger.id IS NULL
       ), 0) AS reversal_orphan_original_total
FROM luckyhub.points_ledger reversal
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.points_ledger original_ledger
    ON original_ledger.id = reversal.reversal_of_ledger_id
WHERE reversal.business_type = 'REVERSAL'
   OR reversal.reversal_of_ledger_id IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS points_redemption_order_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(redemption.status = 'PROCESSING'), 0) AS processing_redemption_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(redemption.status = 'COMPLETED'), 0) AS completed_redemption_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(redemption.status = 'REVERSED'), 0) AS reversed_redemption_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(redemption.sku_id IS NOT NULL AND redemption.offer_id IS NULL), 0) AS legacy_sku_redemption_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(redemption.sku_id IS NULL AND redemption.offer_id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS hmall_offer_redemption_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           (redemption.sku_id IS NULL AND redemption.offer_id IS NULL)
           OR (redemption.sku_id IS NOT NULL AND redemption.offer_id IS NOT NULL)
       ), 0) AS invalid_redemption_source_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(user_record.id IS NULL), 0) AS redemption_missing_marketing_user_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           CAST(redemption.unit_points AS DECIMAL(65, 0)) * redemption.quantity
               <> redemption.total_points
       ), 0) AS redemption_price_calculation_mismatch_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(redemption.status = 'REVERSED' AND redemption.reversal_no IS NULL), 0)
           AS reversed_redemption_missing_reversal_key_total
FROM luckyhub.points_redemption_order redemption
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.sys_user user_record ON user_record.id = redemption.user_id;

SELECT redemption.status,
       COUNT(*) AS redemption_status_total
FROM luckyhub.points_redemption_order redemption
GROUP BY redemption.status
ORDER BY redemption.status;

SELECT redemption.product_type,
       COUNT(*) AS redemption_product_type_total
FROM luckyhub.points_redemption_order redemption
GROUP BY redemption.product_type
ORDER BY redemption.product_type;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS redemption_source_reference_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           redemption.sku_id IS NOT NULL AND sku_record.id IS NULL
       ), 0) AS legacy_sku_orders_missing_sku_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           redemption.sku_id IS NOT NULL
           AND sku_record.id IS NOT NULL
           AND product_record.id IS NULL
       ), 0) AS legacy_sku_orders_missing_product_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           redemption.offer_id IS NOT NULL AND offer_record.id IS NULL
       ), 0) AS hmall_offer_orders_missing_offer_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           redemption.offer_id IS NOT NULL
           AND offer_record.id IS NOT NULL
           AND (
               redemption.hmall_item_id IS NULL
               OR redemption.hmall_item_id <> offer_record.hmall_item_id
           )
       ), 0) AS hmall_offer_orders_offer_item_mismatch_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           redemption.offer_id IS NOT NULL
           AND offer_record.id IS NOT NULL
           AND item_record.id IS NULL
       ), 0) AS hmall_offer_orders_missing_item_total
FROM luckyhub.points_redemption_order redemption
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.product_sku sku_record ON sku_record.id = redemption.sku_id
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.product product_record ON product_record.id = sku_record.product_id
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.points_redemption_offer offer_record ON offer_record.id = redemption.offer_id
LEFT JOIN hm_item.item item_record ON item_record.id = offer_record.hmall_item_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS points_redemption_offer_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(offer.status = 1), 0) AS enabled_offer_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(offer.status = 0), 0) AS disabled_offer_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(offer.status NOT IN (0, 1) OR offer.status IS NULL), 0) AS unexpected_offer_status_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(item_record.id IS NULL), 0) AS offer_missing_hm_item_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(offer.unit_points <= 0), 0) AS offer_nonpositive_points_total,
       (
           SELECT COUNT(*)
           FROM (
               SELECT hmall_item_id
               FROM luckyhub.points_redemption_offer
               GROUP BY hmall_item_id
               HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
           ) duplicate_offer_items
       ) AS duplicate_offer_item_groups
FROM luckyhub.points_redemption_offer offer
LEFT JOIN hm_item.item item_record ON item_record.id = offer.hmall_item_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_physical_redemption_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(redemption.address_snapshot_id IS NULL), 0)
           AS completed_physical_redemptions_missing_snapshot_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           redemption.address_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL
           AND snapshot_record.id IS NULL
       ), 0) AS completed_physical_redemptions_orphan_snapshot_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           snapshot_record.id IS NOT NULL
           AND (
               snapshot_record.source_type <> 'POINTS_REDEMPTION'
               OR snapshot_record.source_id <> CAST(redemption.id AS CHAR)
               OR snapshot_record.user_id <> redemption.user_id
           )
       ), 0) AS completed_physical_redemptions_snapshot_mismatch_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(redemption.shipping_order_id IS NULL), 0)
           AS completed_physical_redemptions_missing_shipping_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           redemption.shipping_order_id IS NOT NULL
           AND shipping_record.id IS NULL
       ), 0) AS completed_physical_redemptions_orphan_shipping_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           shipping_record.id IS NOT NULL
           AND (
               shipping_record.source_type <> 'POINTS_REDEMPTION'
               OR shipping_record.source_id <> CAST(redemption.id AS CHAR)
               OR shipping_record.target_user_id <> redemption.user_id
               OR shipping_record.address_snapshot_id <> redemption.address_snapshot_id
           )
       ), 0) AS completed_physical_redemptions_shipping_mismatch_total
FROM luckyhub.points_redemption_order redemption
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.shipping_address_snapshot snapshot_record
    ON snapshot_record.id = redemption.address_snapshot_id
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.shipping_order shipping_record
    ON shipping_record.id = redemption.shipping_order_id
WHERE redemption.status = 'COMPLETED'
  AND redemption.product_type = 'PHYSICAL';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS settled_redemption_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           redemption.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REVERSED')
           AND (
               debit_ledger.id IS NULL
               OR debit_ledger.user_id <> redemption.user_id
               OR debit_ledger.direction <> 'DEBIT'
               OR debit_ledger.amount <> redemption.total_points
           )
       ), 0) AS completed_redemptions_missing_debit_ledger_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           redemption.status = 'REVERSED'
           AND (
               reversal_ledger.id IS NULL
               OR debit_ledger.id IS NULL
               OR reversal_ledger.user_id <> redemption.user_id
               OR reversal_ledger.direction <> 'CREDIT'
               OR reversal_ledger.reversal_of_ledger_id <> debit_ledger.id
               OR reversal_ledger.amount <> debit_ledger.amount
           )
       ), 0) AS reversed_redemptions_missing_reversal_ledger_total
FROM luckyhub.points_redemption_order redemption
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.points_ledger debit_ledger
    ON debit_ledger.business_type = 'REDEMPTION'
    AND debit_ledger.business_id = redemption.redemption_no
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.points_ledger reversal_ledger
    ON reversal_ledger.business_type = 'REVERSAL'
    AND reversal_ledger.business_id = redemption.reversal_no;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS redemption_ledger_entry_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(redemption_record.id IS NULL), 0) AS debit_ledger_missing_redemption_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(
           redemption_record.id IS NOT NULL
           AND (
               redemption_record.user_id <> ledger.user_id
               OR redemption_record.total_points <> ledger.amount
           )
       ), 0) AS debit_ledger_redemption_mismatch_total
FROM luckyhub.points_ledger ledger
LEFT JOIN luckyhub.points_redemption_order redemption_record
    ON redemption_record.redemption_no = ledger.business_id
WHERE ledger.business_type = 'REDEMPTION';

-- Read-only aggregate preflight. Run only with an already-confirmed SELECT-only account.
-- Do not retain row-level client output; this script emits only version, schema inventory,
-- status/amount aggregates, and aggregate mismatch counts.

SELECT VERSION() AS mysql_server_version;

SELECT table_schema, table_name
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema IN ('luckyhub', 'hm_trade', 'hm_pay')
  AND table_name IN (
    'mall_order', 'payment_order', 'order', 'pay_order', 'pay_message_outbox'
  )
ORDER BY table_schema, table_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS marketing_order_total
FROM luckyhub.mall_order;

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM luckyhub.mall_order
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS marketing_payment_total,
       COALESCE(SUM(amount_cent), 0) AS amount_cent_sum,
       MIN(amount_cent) AS amount_cent_min,
       MAX(amount_cent) AS amount_cent_max
FROM luckyhub.payment_order;

SELECT status, callback_result, COUNT(*) AS row_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(amount_cent), 0) AS amount_cent_sum
FROM luckyhub.payment_order
GROUP BY status, callback_result
ORDER BY status, callback_result;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_multiple_payment_attempts,
       COALESCE(MAX(payment_attempt_count), 0) AS max_payment_attempts_for_one_order
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS payment_attempt_count
    FROM luckyhub.payment_order
    GROUP BY order_no
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) attempts;

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM luckyhub.payment_order p
        LEFT JOIN luckyhub.mall_order o ON o.order_no = p.order_no
        WHERE o.id IS NULL) AS orphan_payment_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM luckyhub.mall_order o
        LEFT JOIN luckyhub.payment_order p ON p.order_no = o.order_no
        WHERE p.id IS NULL) AS orders_without_payment_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM luckyhub.payment_order p
        JOIN luckyhub.mall_order o ON o.order_no = p.order_no
        WHERE p.amount_cent <> o.payable_amount_cent) AS payment_amount_mismatch_count;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS trade_order_total,
       MIN(total_fee) AS total_fee_min,
       MAX(total_fee) AS total_fee_max
FROM hm_trade.`order`;

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS row_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(total_fee), 0) AS total_fee_sum
FROM hm_trade.`order`
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS pay_order_total,
       MIN(amount) AS amount_min,
       MAX(amount) AS amount_max
FROM hm_pay.pay_order;

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS row_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount_sum
FROM hm_pay.pay_order
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status;

SELECT event_type, status, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM hm_pay.pay_message_outbox
GROUP BY event_type, status
ORDER BY event_type, status;

-- Loop through all keys to see if they can be used , when a key is not available, exit
for i= 1, keySize do
    -- search lock xid
    result = redis.call('HGET',KEYS[i],'xid');
    -- if lock xid is nil
    if (not result)
        -- set 'no' mean There is need to store lock information
        then array[i]='no'
        else
           if (result ~= ARGV[3])
           then
               -- return fail
               return 0
           else
               -- set 'yes' mean  There is not need to store lock information
               array[i]= 'yes'
           end
    end
end
-- Loop through array
for i =1, keySize do
    -- if is no ,The lock information is stored
    if(array[i] == 'no')
        then
            -- set xid
            redis.call('HSET',KEYS[i],'xid',ARGV[3]);
            -- set transactionId
            redis.call('HSET',KEYS[i],'transactionId',ARGV[(i-1)*6+4]);
            -- set branchId
            redis.call('HSET',KEYS[i],'branchId',ARGV[(i-1)*6+5]);
            -- set resourceId
            redis.call('HSET',KEYS[i],'resourceId',ARGV[(i-1)*6+6]);
            -- set tableName
            redis.call('HSET',KEYS[i],'tableName',ARGV[(i-1)*6+7]);
            -- set rowKey
            redis.call('HSET',KEYS[i],'rowKey',ARGV[(i-1)*6+8]);
            -- set pk
            redis.call('HSET',KEYS[i],'pk',ARGV[(i-1)*6+9]);
    -- exit if
    end
-- exit for
end
-- set SEATA_GLOBAL_LOCK
redis.call('HSET',KEYS[(keySize+1)],KEYS[(keySize+2)],ARGV[(argSize+0)]);

# 脚本说明

## [client](https://github.com/seata/seata/tree/develop/script/client) 

> 存放用于客户端的配置和SQL

- at: AT模式下的 `undo_log` 建表语句
- conf: 客户端的配置文件
- saga: SAGA 模式下所需表的建表语句
- spring: SpringBoot 应用支持的配置文件

## [server](https://github.com/seata/seata/tree/develop/script/server)

> 存放server侧所需SQL和部署脚本

- db: server 侧的保存模式为 `db` 时所需表的建表语句
- docker-compose: server 侧通过 docker-compose 部署的脚本
- helm: server 侧通过 Helm 部署的脚本
- kubernetes: server 侧通过 Kubernetes 部署的脚本

## [config-center](https://github.com/seata/seata/tree/develop/script/config-center)

> 用于存放各种配置中心的初始化脚本，执行时都会读取 `config.txt`配置文件，并写入配置中心

- nacos: 用于向 Nacos 中添加配置
- zk: 用于向 Zookeeper 中添加配置，脚本依赖 Zookeeper 的相关脚本，需要手动下载；ZooKeeper相关的配置可以写在 `zk-params.txt` 中，也可以在执行的时候输入
- apollo: 向 Apollo 中添加配置，Apollo 的地址端口等可以写在 `apollo-params.txt`，也可以在执行的时候输入
- etcd3: 用于向 Etcd3 中添加配置
- consul: 用于向 consul 中添加配置

## 打包
./mvnw -Prelease-seata -Dmaven.test.skip=true clean install -U

# Script Description

## [client](https://github.com/seata/seata/tree/develop/script/client) 

> Store configuration and SQL for client side

- at: Script of create table `undo_log` for AT mode.
- conf: Configuration which client need.
- saga: Script of create table in SAGA mode
- spring: Configuration for Spring Boot 

## [server](https://github.com/seata/seata/tree/develop/script/server)

> Store SQL and deploy script for server side

- db: Create table script for server when store mode is `db`
- docker-compose: Script for deploy server by docker-compose
- helm: Script for deploy server by Helm
- kubernetes: Script for deploy server by Kubernetes

## [config-center](https://github.com/seata/seata/tree/develop/script/config-center)

> Store initialize script for configuration center, will use `config.txt` as configuration when initial

- nacos: Initialize script for Nacos
- zk: Initialize script for ZooKeeper, the script need related script in Zookeeper, you need download yourself. You can modify `zk-params.txt` to change the ZooKeeper server configuration, or input when execute also
- apollo: Initialize script for Apollo. You can modify `apollo-params.txt` to change the Apollo server configuration, or input when execute also
- etcd3: Initialize script for Etcd3
- consul: Initialize script for consul

from pathlib import Path
import re
import unittest


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PORTAL = ROOT / "nginx" / "html" / "hmall-portal"


def read(name: str) -> str:
    return (PORTAL / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")


class AddressPageContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_address_page_uses_authenticated_hmall_crud(self):
        page = read("address.html")
        self.assertIn("js/common.js", page)
        self.assertIn('axios.get("/addresses")', page)
        self.assertIn('axios.post("/addresses"', page)
        self.assertRegex(page, r'axios\.put\(["`]\/addresses\/\$\{')
        self.assertRegex(page, r'axios\.delete\(["`]\/addresses\/\$\{')
        self.assertNotIn("userId", page)

    def test_address_page_has_real_operational_copy(self):
        page = read("address.html")
        self.assertIn("收货地址", page)
        self.assertIn("设为默认地址", page)
        self.assertNotRegex(page, re.compile(r"测试|E2E", re.IGNORECASE))


class OrderConfirmationContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_order_confirmation_requires_a_real_selected_address(self):
        page = read("order-confirm.html")
        self.assertIn("addressId: null", page)
        self.assertIn('axios.get("/addresses")', page)
        self.assertIn("if(!this.params.addressId)", page)
        self.assertNotIn("addressId: 61", page)
        self.assertNotIn("朝阳区三环到四环之间", page)

    def test_order_confirmation_displays_real_membership_discount_quote(self):
        page = read("order-confirm.html")
        self.assertIn('/marketing/memberships/me', page)
        self.assertIn("商品原价", page)
        self.assertIn("GOLD 会员优惠", page)
        self.assertIn("membershipDiscount", page)
        self.assertIn("payablePrice", page)

    def test_order_confirmation_lists_and_submits_applicable_coupon(self):
        page = read("order-confirm.html")
        self.assertIn("/marketing/coupons/checkout/applicable", page)
        self.assertIn("selectedCouponId", page)
        self.assertIn("coupon.userCouponId", page)
        self.assertIn("couponDiscount", page)
        self.assertIn("couponId: this.selectedCouponId", page)


class StorefrontOrdersContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_shared_storefront_header_exposes_my_orders_and_coupons(self):
        header = read("js/top.js")

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import unittest


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
COMPOSE_FILE = ROOT / "compose.yaml"
MIGRATION_FILE = ROOT / "mysql" / "migrations" / "V001__hmall_marketing_integration.sql"
ITEM_MIGRATION_FILE = ROOT / "mysql" / "migrations" / "V004__create_item_service_database.sql"
CART_MIGRATION_FILE = ROOT / "mysql" / "migrations" / "V005__create_cart_service_database.sql"
NACOS_SCHEMA_FILE = ROOT / "mysql" / "nacos.sql"


def read(relative_path: str) -> str:
    return (ROOT / relative_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def compose_config(*profiles: str) -> dict:
    command = [
        "docker",
        "compose",
        "--env-file",
        str(ROOT / ".env.example"),
        "-f",
        str(COMPOSE_FILE),
    ]
    for profile in profiles:
        command.extend(["--profile", profile])
    command.extend(["config", "--format", "json"])
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise AssertionError(f"docker compose config failed:\n{result.stdout}\n{result.stderr}")
    return json.loads(result.stdout)

class NginxRoutingContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.conf = read("nginx/nginx.conf")
        cls.normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", cls.conf)

    def test_both_static_sites_are_served(self):
        self.assertIn("listen 18080", self.normalized)
        self.assertIn("listen 18081", self.normalized)
        self.assertIn("/usr/share/nginx/html/hmall-portal", self.conf)
        self.assertIn("/usr/share/nginx/html/hmall-admin", self.conf)

    def test_marketing_routes_keep_api_prefix_after_stripping_marketing_segment(self):
        locations = re.findall(
            r"location\s+\^~\s+/api/marketing/\s*\{([^}]+)\}", self.conf, re.S
        )
        self.assertEqual(2, len(locations))
        for body in locations:
            self.assertIn("set $gateway_backend hm-gateway:8080;", body)
            self.assertRegex(body, r"rewrite\s+\^/api/marketing/\(\.\*\)\$\s+/api/\$1\s+break;")
            self.assertIn("proxy_pass http://$gateway_backend;", body)

    def test_exact_legacy_marketing_login_stays_on_marketing_until_identity_cutover(self):
        servers = re.findall(r"(?ms)^    server\s*\{(.*?)^    \}", self.conf)
        self.assertEqual(2, len(servers))
        for server in servers:
            include = "include /etc/nginx/snippets/marketing-auth-login.conf;"
            self.assertEqual(1, server.count(include))
            self.assertLess(
                server.index(include),
                server.index("location ^~ /api/marketing/"),
            )
        snippet_path = ROOT / "nginx" / "snippets" / "marketing-auth-login.conf"
        self.assertTrue(snippet_path.is_file(), "shared marketing login snippet must exist")
        snippet = read("nginx/snippets/marketing-auth-login.conf")
        locations = re.findall(
            r"location\s*=\s*/api/marketing/auth/login\s*\{([^}]+)\}",
            snippet,
            re.S,
        )
        self.assertEqual(1, len(locations))
        self.assertEqual(1, len(re.findall(r"location\s", snippet)))
        body = locations[0]
        self.assertIn("set $marketing_backend marketing-service:8080;", body)
        self.assertIn("rewrite ^/api/marketing/auth/login$ /api/auth/login break;", body)
        self.assertIn("proxy_pass http://$marketing_backend;", body)
        for header in (
            "proxy_set_header Host $host;",
            "proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;",
            "proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;",
            "proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;",
            'proxy_set_header user-info "";',
        ):
            self.assertIn(header, body)
        self.assertNotIn("/callbacks/payments", self.conf)
        self.assertNotIn("/callbacks/payments", snippet)

    def test_hmall_api_routes_are_sent_through_the_authenticating_gateway(self):
        self.assertEqual(4, len(re.findall(r"location\s+\^~\s+/api/", self.conf)))
        self.assertEqual(
            4,
            len(re.findall(r"proxy_pass\s+http://\$gateway_backend;", self.conf)),
        )
        self.assertGreaterEqual(
            len(re.findall(r"rewrite\s+\^/api/\(\.\*\)\$\s+/\$1\s+break;", self.conf)),
            2,
        )
        self.assertNotIn("proxy_pass http://mall-service:8080", self.conf)
        for upstream in (
            "item-service:8081",
            "cart-service:8082",
            "user-service:8083",
            "trade-service:8084",
            "pay-service:8085",
        ):
            with self.subTest(upstream=upstream):
                self.assertNotIn(f"proxy_pass http://{upstream}", self.conf)

    def test_proxy_upstreams_use_docker_runtime_dns(self):
        self.assertRegex(
            self.conf,
            r"resolver\s+127\.0\.0\.11\s+valid=10s\s+ipv6=off;",
        )
        snippet = read("nginx/snippets/marketing-auth-login.conf")
        for content, backend, upstream, count in (
            (self.conf, "gateway_backend", "hm-gateway:8080", 4),
            (snippet, "marketing_backend", "marketing-service:8080", 1),
        ):
            with self.subTest(backend=backend):
                self.assertEqual(
                    count,
                    len(re.findall(rf"set\s+\${backend}\s+{re.escape(upstream)};", content)),
                )
                self.assertEqual(
                    count,
                    len(re.findall(rf"proxy_pass\s+http://\${backend};", content)),
                )
        self.assertEqual(
            4,
            len(re.findall(r"proxy_pass\s+http://\$gateway_backend;", self.conf)),
        )

    def test_runtime_upstream_is_initialized_before_rewrite_breaks(self):
        marketing_location = (
            r"location\s+\^~\s+/api/marketing/\s*\{\s*"
            r"set\s+\$gateway_backend\s+hm-gateway:8080;\s*"
            r"rewrite\s+\^/api/marketing/\(\.\*\)\$\s+/api/\$1\s+break;\s*"
            r"proxy_pass\s+http://\$gateway_backend;"
        )
        gateway_location = (
            r"location\s+\^~\s+/api/\s*\{\s*"
            r"set\s+\$gateway_backend\s+hm-gateway:8080;\s*"
            r"rewrite\s+\^/api/\(\.\*\)\$\s+/\$1\s+break;\s*"
            r"proxy_pass\s+http://\$gateway_backend;"
        )
        login_location = (
            r"location\s*=\s*/api/marketing/auth/login\s*\{\s*"
            r"set\s+\$marketing_backend\s+marketing-service:8080;\s*"
            r"rewrite\s+\^/api/marketing/auth/login\$\s+/api/auth/login\s+break;\s*"
            r"proxy_pass\s+http://\$marketing_backend;"
        )
        self.assertEqual(2, len(re.findall(marketing_location, self.conf)))
        self.assertEqual(2, len(re.findall(gateway_location, self.conf)))
        snippet = read("nginx/snippets/marketing-auth-login.conf")
        self.assertEqual(1, len(re.findall(login_location, snippet)))

    def test_gateway_keeps_marketing_compatibility_and_callback_rewrite(self):
        application = read("hm-gateway/src/main/resources/application.yaml")
        self.assertRegex(
            application,
            r"(?ms)^\s+- id: marketing-payment-callback-compat\s+"
            r"uri: lb://marketing-service\s+predicates:\s+"
            r"- Path=/api/callbacks/payments,/api/callbacks/payments/\*\*\s+"
            r"filters:\s+- StripPrefix=1\s*$",
        )
        self.assertIn("- POST /api/shipping/callbacks/logistics", application)
        self.assertNotIn("POST /api/auth/login", application)
        self.assertNotIn("POST /api/callbacks/payments", application)
        self.assertNotIn("POST /callbacks/payments", application)
        self.assertIn("- id: marketing-payment-callback-native", application)
        self.assertIn("Path=/callbacks/payments,/callbacks/payments/**", application)
        legacy = re.search(r"(?ms)^\s+- id: marketing-legacy\s+.*?(?=^\s+- id:|\Z)", application)
        self.assertIsNotNone(legacy)
        self.assertIn("uri: lb://marketing-service", legacy.group(0))
        self.assertIn("Path=/api/**", legacy.group(0))
        for route_id in (
            "item-service",
            "cart-service",
            "user-service",
            "trade-service",
            "pay-service",
            "marketing-payment-callback-native",
        ):
            self.assertLess(application.index(f"id: {route_id}"), legacy.start())
        self.assertLess(
            application.index("id: marketing-payment-callback-compat"),
            application.index("id: marketing-legacy"),
        )

import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import unittest


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SEATA_SQL = ROOT / "mysql" / "seata" / "seata-tc.sql"


def read(relative_path: str) -> str:
    return (ROOT / relative_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def compose_config() -> dict:
    result = subprocess.run(
        [
            "docker", "compose", "--env-file", str(ROOT / ".env.example"),
            "-f", str(ROOT / "compose.yaml"), "config", "--format", "json",
        ],
        cwd=ROOT,
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise AssertionError(
            f"docker compose config failed:\n{result.stdout}\n{result.stderr}"
        )
    return json.loads(result.stdout)


class SeataDatabaseContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.sql = SEATA_SQL.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        cls.normalized = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", cls.sql).lower()

    def test_database_and_dedicated_user_are_provisioned_repeatably(self):
        self.assertRegex(
            self.normalized,
            r"create database if not exists\s+`?seata`?.*character set\s+utf8mb4",
        )
        self.assertIn("create user if not exists 'seata_app'@'%'", self.normalized)
        self.assertIn("alter user ''seata_app''@''%'' identified by", self.normalized)
        self.assertRegex(
            self.normalized,
            r"grant\s+select\s*,\s*insert\s*,\s*update\s*,\s*delete\s+on\s+`?seata`?\.\*\s+to\s+'seata_app'@'%'",
        )
        self.assertNotRegex(
            self.normalized,
            r"grant\s+all privileges.*'seata_app'",
        )

    def test_all_tc_tables_and_distributed_locks_are_idempotent(self):
        for table in (
            "global_table",
            "branch_table",
            "lock_table",
            "distributed_lock",
            "vgroup_table",
        ):
            with self.subTest(table=table):
                self.assertRegex(
                    self.normalized,
                    rf"create table if not exists\s+`?{table}`?",
                )
        self.assertEqual(4, len(re.findall(r"insert ignore into\s+`?distributed_lock`?", self.normalized)))

    def test_schema_init_mounts_and_executes_seata_sql_with_injected_password(self):
        service = compose_config()["services"]["schema-init"]
        mounts = {
            mount["target"]: mount for mount in service["volumes"]
        }
        self.assertIn("/migrations/seata-tc.sql", mounts)
        self.assertTrue(mounts["/migrations/seata-tc.sql"]["read_only"])
        self.assertIn("SEATA_DB_PASSWORD", service["environment"])
        command = " ".join(
            service["command"]
            if isinstance(service["command"], list)
            else [service["command"]]
        )
        self.assertIn("SET @seata_db_password", command)
        self.assertIn("/migrations/seata-tc.sql", command)

class SeataComposeContractTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):

    def test_tc_uses_pinned_image_resources_and_dependencies(self):

    username: ${RABBITMQ_USERNAME:}
    password: ${RABBITMQ_PASSWORD:}
    virtual-host: ${RABBITMQ_VHOST:/dongqh}

    publisher-returns: true
    template:
      mandatory: true
    listener:

        acknowledge-mode: auto
        default-requeue-rejected: false
        retry:
          enabled: true
          max-retries: 2
          initial-interval: 500ms
          multiplier: 2
          max-interval: 2s
